k.v: प्रचोदनी कुली क्षुद्रा दुःस्पर्शा राष्ट्रिकेत्यपि। नीली काला क्लीतकिका ग्रामीणा मधुपर्णिका॥
काला मसूरविदलार्धचन्द्रा कालमेषिका। मधुकं क्लीतकं यष्टिमधुकं मधुयष्टिका॥
सुषवी कारवी पृथ्वी पृथुः कालोपकुञ्जिका। आर्द्रकं शृङ्गबेरं स्यादथच्छत्रा वितुन्नकम्.।

। ma॰ ta॰ “ezu pramARaM vakzyAmaH । atra navyavardDamAnaH “ekadvitritadaDikAnyatamadinavfttyAkAlikavfzwyuttarEkatrisaptAhetyatra uttaradinatvasya pUrvadinanirUpyatvAt uttaratvapUrvatvayorvirudDatayA na tu tadavacCedakadinasyApIti । tenEkasmin dine vfzwyA taddinamAtratyAgaH dvitIyadinAdO tu antima dinamAraBya tryahasaptAhayostyAgaH । taTA ca vyAsaH “no sanDyAgarjite prAhurvratopanayanaM buDAH । na ca vfzwAvaTAkAla vfzwAvA''saptavAsarAn” । AsaptavAsarAnityatra upasTitatvAdvfzwikAlamAdAya saptAhagaRanA AsaptabAsarAniti aDikasaMKyAvyavacCedArTam । etena viDyanuvAdaBiyA aDikasaMKyA nirastA । atra vfzwyuttarameva saptAhatyAgaH etadvacanantu tftIyAdidivasIyAkAlavfzwyaBiprAyeRa । “atodinenEkadinaM tyAjyaM dvitIyena dinatrayam । tftIyena ca saptAhaM tyajedakAla varzaRe” nyAyaratnaparigfhItavAkye'pi dinena dinavfttivarzaRena evaM dvitIyenetyAdO jYeyam । ataeva nyAyaratne'pi vfzwyattaratvamuktaM natu vfzwiyuktadinottaratvamiti । ekAdidinavfttitvaviSezaRaM dinAlpatvabahutvajYApanArTamiti । SrIpativyavahAranirRaye “AkAlikIM vfzwimavekzya gantA padaM na gacCecCuBamAtmanIcCan । kzOraM vrataYcApi SuBABilAzI kadApi nEva manasApi kuryyAt” । atra nosanDyA garjita iti AkAlikIvfzwimavekzya ityAdi SravaRAt । “vrate'hni pUrvasanDyAyAM vAridoyadi garjati । vratantatra tu nEva syAditi Darmmo vyavasTitaH” iti vacane pUrvapadamapi kAraRatAgrAhakatvena parasanDyAvyAvarttakam । anyaTA saMkrAntibadBAvinimittatvena parasanDyAyAM garjite'pi vratavEguRyaM syAt । etena pUrvadine sAyaM sanDyAgarjane'pi paradine vratanizeDa iti mETilamataM cintyamiti । saptamyarTAnupapatteH gItAyAM “mayEvEte nihatAHpUrvameva nimittamAtraM Bava savyasAcin!” itivat svarUpAKyAnaparaM bA pUrvapadam । kAmarUpIyanibanDe'pyevam । yogISvaraH “caturmAse nivftte tu cakrapARO samutTite । akAlavfzwiM jAnIyAt yAvanna supyate hariH” । atra yAvadvizRumahotsava iti jImUtavAhanaH paWati mahotsavaH PAlgunI pUrRimA iti vyAKyAti ca । kftyacintAmaRiBojarAjavyavahArasamuccayaSrIDarasamuccayezu “pOzAdi caturo mAsAn jYeyA vfzwirakAlajA । vratayajYAdikaM tatra varjayet sapta vAsarAn । mArgAnmAsAt praBfti munayovyAsabAlmIkigargAScEtraM yAvat pravarzaRaviDO neti kAlaM vadanti । nAqIjaNGaH suragurumunirvakti vfzwerakAlO mAsAvetO na SuBaPaladO pOzamAGO na SezAH । mArgAdityavaDO paYcamI nAmiviDO । vyAsavAlmIkigargA ityatra vyAsabAlmIkiSizyA iti jImUtavAhanaH paWati । pravarzaRetyatra CandoBaNga ArzatvAt soQavyaH । evaM pakzatraye vyavasTite yena sarvaparigrahaH syAt tasyEva grahaRamiti nyAyenAdyaH pakzaH SreyAn, taduttarantu pakzadvayamApadatyantApadvizayamevamanyatrApi । ataeva rAjamArttaRqe “uktAni pratizidDAni punaH samBAvitAni ca । sApekzanirapekzARi SrutivAkyAni kovidEH” । iti SezacaraRe mImAMsyAnIha kovidEriti kftyacintAmaRO pAWaH । yadvA “spazwasya tu viDernAnyErupasaMhAra izyate” iti nyAyena dozAtiSayArTa eva sAmAnyanizeDe viSezanizeDaH । tatrApi viSezOkto vfhaspatinA “vfzwiH karoti dozaM tAvannAkAlasamBavA rAjYaH । yAvanna Bavati yAne narapaSucaraRANkitA vasuDA” । kASyapaH “FkzEkamandiragatO yadi jIbaBAnU SukrI'stagaH suravarEkaguruSca siMhe । nAraByate vratavivAhagfhapratizWA kzOrAdikarmma gamanAgamanaYca DIrEH” । fkzEkamandiragatAviti viSizwaM na pfTak taTA ca “ekarASigatO syAtAmekarkzavizaye yadi । gurvAdityO tadA tyAjyA yajYodvAhAdikAH kriyAH” । cAturmAsyavrate tu pratiprasavamAha mahABArate “cAturmAsyavratAramBamastage'pi gurO BfgO । KaRqe'vApi tiTO kuryyAt evameva samApanam” । gArgyaH “jIvAditye bAle Sukre UrdDvaM daSAhAnmANgalyaM pratizWAM KAtaYca kuryyAt” । mANgalyaM vivAhAdi । KAtaM puzkariRyAdi । rAjamArcaRqe hArItaH “yAtrAM cUqAM vivAhaM SrutivivaraviDiM grAmasadmapraveSaM prAsAdodyAnaharmmyAn suranaraBavanAramBavidyApradAnam । mOYjIbanDaM pratizWAM maRivarakanakADAraRaM kurvate ye mftyustezAYca siMhe gurudinakarayorekarASisTayoSca” । siMhe gurudinakarayoH--siMhasTe gurO ravO ca ekarASisTayoryugapattayoreva “tezAYca siMha” ityatra “tezAM harIjya” iti pAWAntaram । harIjye--siMhe vfhaspatO । somaSeKarAKyanibanDe “vApIkUpataqAgayAgagamanakzOrapratizWAvrataM vidyAmandirakarRaveDanamahAdAnaM vanaM sevanam । tIrTasnAnavivAhadevaBavanaYcAnAdidevekzaRaM dUreREva jijIvizuH pariharedastaM gate BArgave” । dIpikAyAm ‘gurvAditye gurO siMhe nazwe Sukre malimluce । yAmyAyane harO supte sarvakarmARi varjayet’ । sarvakarmmARIti vacanAntaroktaprAtisvikanizidDakarmaparaM lAGavAt anyaTA atiprasaNgApatteH । vfhadrAjamArttaRqaH ‘yAtrAvivAhavratabanDaveSmaprAsAdacUqAkaraRaM hitEzI । nazwe BfgO nopadiSennarARAM devapratizWAmapi karRaveDam । hitvAdyaM SuBakarmARi kuryyAdastamite site । vivAhaM meKalAbanDaM yAtrAYca parivarjayet” । atra yAtrAYceti cakAraH pUrvavacanopAttamunyantaroktaprAtisvikanizidDakarmmARi sa muccinoti । “bAle Sukre, vfdDe Sukre, nazwe Sukre, jIve nazwe । bAle jIve, jIve siMhe, siMhAditye jIvAditye । tayA malimluce mAsi surAcAryye'ticArage । vApIkUpataqAgAdikriyAH prAguditAstyajet” । evaYca kAlASudDO vidyAramBaM na kuryyAt tadviDAnaYca vizRuDarmmottare । “saMprApte paYcame varze aprasupte janArddane । zazWIM pratipadaYcEva varjayitvA taTAzwamIm । riktAM paYcadaSIYcEva sOrimOmadinantaTA । evaM suniScite kAle vidyAramBaH praSasyate” devalaH “bAle vfdDe taTEvAste kurute dEtyamantriRi । udvAhitAyAM kanyAyAM dampatyorekanASanam” । antaka iti SezaH । rAjamArttaRqe “siMhe gurO pariRItA patimAtmAnamAtmajAn hanti । kramaSastrizu pitrAdizu vaSizWagargAdayaH prAhuH” । pitrAdizu--siMhaGawakamaGA pUrvaPAlgunyuttaraPAlgunIpraTamapAdezu । pratiprasavamAha SAtAtapaH “mAGyAM yadi maGA nAsti siMhaM gururakAraRam” । tatrEva hemAdriDftamARqavyavacanam “SrutiveDajAtakAnnaprASanacUqAdikaH sarvaH । raviBavanasTe jIve kAryyovarjyovivAhastu” । mADyAM maGAyoge tu fkzEkamandiragatAvityAdinA sarvakarmanizeDAt । aTEvaM vivAho'pi SrUyate taTAca rAjamArttaRqe dakzaH “gurO harisTe na vivAhamAhurhArItagargapramuKAmunIndrAH । yadA na mAGI maGasaMyutA syAt tadA ca kanTodvahanaM vadanti” । itTaYca mAGyAM maGAyogABAve'pi SrutiveDAdi, maGAsTe'pi gurO Bavati vivAhastu gurormazAparityAgAdeva taTAca mARqavyaH “maGAfkzaM parityajya yadA siMhe gururBavet । tatrAbde kanyakA coQA sumagA supriyA Bavet” । vAtsyAyanaH “yAtrodvAhapratizWAdigfhacUqAvratAdikam । yatnato varjayeccEva jIve vakrAticArage । kIrttiBaNgaH pratizWAyAM, BayaM cOrAttaTA'Dvani । cUqodvAhe Bavenmftyurvrate hAni, rBayaM gfhe । aticAre tripakzaH syAt vakre pakzacatuzwayam । na kuryyAttatra yAtrAdi gurorvakrAticArayoH” gargaH “gurorvakrAticAre ca varjayettadanantaram । yajYavratavivAhAdAvazwAviMSativAsarAn” । mARqavyaH “yadA vakrAticArAByAM rASiM gacCati vAkpatiH । dinAmi saptaviMSAni tyaktvA karmma samAcaret” । atrApi pUrvaH pUrvaH pakzaH SreyAn । rASiM--rASyantaram anyaTA vyarTaM syAt । ataeva nyAyaratnenApi pUrvarASigamizyamARAticAriguruketyuktam । vfhadrAjamArttaRqe “vakAticAropagatAH kujAdyA yadyanyarASO, parivarjanIyAH । yaTAkramasTAH svagfhasTitA vA na varjanIvA yavanA vadanti” । vyavahArasamuccaye kftyacintAmaRO ca hArItaH “kftvA'ticAraM yadi pUrvarASiM nAyAti mantrI vibuDADipAnAm । yAnaM vivAhaM vratabanDagehaM sarvaM tadA hanti mataM munInAm । aticAraM gate jIve vfze vfScikakumBayoH । yajYodvAhAdikaM kuryyAttatra kAlo na lupyate” । kftyakalpalatAyAM vAcaspatimiSrEH “pUrvarASiM yadA tyaktvA apUrRe vatsare guruH । luptaHkAlaH sa vijYeyaH paragehaM gato yadA । mIne meze vfze cEva taTA miTunakanyayoH । aticArAnna dozaH syAnniyataM kAlalopajaH” । dvEtanirRaye “kanyAvfScikamezezu manTaTe ca fze vfze । aticArezu karttarvyavivAhAdi zuDEH sadA” iti amUlakamityuktam । varAhasaMhitAyAm “aticAraM gatojIvastatrEva kurute sTitim । tadA mahAticAraH syAt luptasaMvatsarakriyaH । aticAreRa yorASirlaNGitodevamantriRA । tadAdyo vatsaroluptoyo'narhaH sarvakarmasu” । tatra varze karmmaRoluptatvAt vatsarolupta iti tadAha yo'narha iti । BujabalaBImAdinibanDezu “SuBaM BavanamAsAdya yadAtikramate guruH । atra saMvardDitA kanyA suKaM BarttuH pramodate” dIpikAyAm “trikoRajAyADanalABarASO vakrAticAreRa guruH prayAti । yadA, tadA prAha SuBe vilagne hitAya pARigrahaRaM vaSizWaH” । trikoRaM navapaYcamam । jAyA--saptamaM, DanaM--dvitIyaM, lABa--ekAdaSagfham । ratnakoze “pakzodaSAhAni taTA tripakzI mAsatriBAgaH Kalu zaw ca mAsAH । ezo'ticAraH kaTitograhARAM BOmAdikAnAM paratastu cAraH” । pratizWAkARqe kalpatarO devIpurARam “yaTA jIve sTite siMhe taTEva makarasTite । devArAmataqAgAdipurodyAnagfhARi ca । vivAhAdi mahABAga BayadAni vinirddiSet । yadA dvAdaSage jIge azwame vATa BAskare । pratizWA kAritA vizRormahABayakarI matA” । kftyacintAmaRO devIpurARam “siMhasaMsTaM guruM SukraM sarvAramBezu varjjayet । ArabDaYca na sidDyeta mahABayakaraM Bavet । kUpArAmataqAgezu purodyAnagfhezu ca । siMhasTaM makarasTaYca guruM yatnena varjayet । kArakovrajate nASaM santAnaH kzIyate'cirAt” । guRisarvasve makarasTagurO pravarttakaM narasiMhapurARam “vivAhonEva karttavyaH siMhasaMsTe gurO sadA । makarasTe ca tatkAryyaM kalyARaM sarvvatobuDEH । taTA devIpurARam “makarasTo yadA jIvo varjayet paYcamAMSakam । Sezezvapi ca BAgezu vivAhaH SoBano mataH” । etadvAkyaM vyavahArAparigfhItamiti kftyacintAmaRiH । etenEtadanAkaraM na Bavati kintu mETilAnAmanAcAraH iti svaraso'vagamyate । ataeva ratnAvalyAdizu nIcasTagurAveva doza uktaH । gurornIcasTatvamapi triMSAMSamakararASeH paYcamAMSaM yAvaditi jyotistattve jYeyam । ratnAvalyAm “nIcasTaH siMhagovA yadi Bavati guruH sUryyaraSmO ca lInaH saMyukto vA yadi syAt daSaSatavfRinA kzIRarUpo'Ta bAlaH । yAtrAgehaM vivAhovratamamaragfhaM yajYacUqAdi sarvaM vApI codyAnakUpam na Bavati SuBadaM yadyadizwaYca loke” । SrIpatiratnamAlAyAM kftyacintAmaRO ca vAtsyaH “SAKADipe balini kendragate'Ta vAsmin vAre'sya copanayanaM kaTitaM dvijAnAm । nIcasTite'rigfhage'Ta parAjite vA jIve BfgO vrataviDO smftikarmmahInaH” । asyaSAKADipasya । tena sAmagAnAM kujabAre'pyupanayanam “sAmavedADipo BOmaH” ityuktatvAt । kAmarUpIyanibanDe smftisAgare devIpurARam “makarasTo yadA jovastadA triMSaddinaM tyajet । tyaktvA tu zazwidivarsa kuryyAt karmARi mAnavaH” । rAyamukuwajyotiHkAlakOmudyAm yattu “makarasTaM guruM yatnAt siMhavat parivarjayet । devArAmataqAgezu purodyAnagfhezu ca” ityAdi devalavacanaM tadapi siMhavat parivarjayedityanena yaTA siMhasTasya gurostyAjyatA taTA makarasTasyApIti gamyate । siMhasTa gurormaGAyuktamAGyAM satyAmeva tyAjyatA ato makarasTasyApi gurostasyAmeva tyAjyatA ityavagamyate । ataeva devIpurARam “yaTA jIvasTite siMhe taTEva makarasTite” ityatra yaTAtaTopAdAnam । tadapi deSaviSeza eva dUzaRam taTAhi “gaRqakyA uttare tIre girirAjasya dakziRe । siMhasTaM makarasTaYca guruM yatnena varjayet” । ataevAnyadeSABiprAyeRa BImaparAkrame “vApIkUpataqAgAdi nizidDaM siMhage gurO । makarasTe tu tatkAryyaM na dozaH kAlalopajaH । kAryyaM makarage jIrva vivAhAdyaKilaM buDEH । na tu siMhagate jIve kuryyAdvipraH kaTaYcana” । atra pUrvoktanarasiMhapurARavacane makarasTamAtre vivAha uktaH । ataeva tatsAraBUtaM vyavahAramAtraM vibakzitaM SrIpatinAtmabudDyeti pratijYAyasamayASudDO makarasTavfhaspatidozamanaBiDAya kevalamupanayane nIcasTavfhaspatirnizidDaH । etena dvEtanirRaye SrIpatisaMhitAyAM vyavahAropavfMhitameva vacanaM naca vyavahAravirudDamiti । etena yat makarasTagurvAdO vivAhAdiviDAyakaM vacanaM tadAcAravirahAdanAdaraRIyam iti vAcaspatimiSroktaM heyam makarasTagurO pratizWAvyatiriktakarmmanizeDakaSrIpatigranTavirahAt । aTa tannizeDakamunivacanAni prAmARikAntaraDftatvAdupAdeyAnIti cet tarhi pratiprasavavacanAnyapi taTA । evaYcAticAre vivAhAdinizeDakavacanAni SrIpatinA liKitAni natu tadapavAdakAnIti tena tAnyaprAmARikAnIti yaduktaM tadapi heyam prakfte pUrvoktayuktestOlyAt BujabalaBIme “jIbo'rkeRa yutaH karoti maraRaM bAlAMSukoBAguriH nakzatrEkagato vadanti yavanAH pAdasTito devalaH । prAyogargaparASarAdimunayo necCanti cAstaMgate tasmAdastamite surendrasacive nezwaM vivAhAdikam” SrIpatiratnamAlAyAm “prAgudgataH SiSurahastritayam sitaH syAt paScAddaSAhamitapaYcadinAni vfdDaH । prAk pakzameva kaTito'trivaSizWagargErjIvastu pakzamapi vfdDaSiSurvivarjyaH” । vfdDaSiSutvagantetikvacitpAWaH । sitaH SukraH । iha--paScAddiSi । rAjamArttaRqe “Bavet sanDyAgataH paScAt astamEzyan dinatrayam । dinAni paYca pUrveRa, tatkfte karma varjjayet । bAle bfdDe ca sanDyAMSe catuHpaYcatrivAsarAn । jIve ca BArgave cEva vivAhAdizu varjjayet । bAle bfdDe ca sanDyAyAM nazwe ca Bfgunandane । durBagA cAsatI banDyA mftyuyuktA PalaM kramAt । bAle ca durBagA nArI vfdDe nazwaprajA Bavet । nazwe ca mftyumApnoti sarvamevaM gurAvapi” । vfdDe paYcadinatvakIrttanamapyApadvizayaM jyotiHparASareRa BfgoH pAdAste'pi daSAhaviDAnAt । evaM gurAvapi । ratnamAlAyAM pakzaviDAnAt tayormate na sanDyAyAH pfTaNnirdeSo'pi vfdDatvenEva tadgrahaRAt । dIpikAyAm “gurvvAditye, gurO siMhe, nazwe Sukre malimluce । yAmyAyane harO supte sarbakarmmARi varjayet । tatrEva “no SukrAste'zwame'rke gurusahitaravO janmamAse'zwamendO, vizwO, mAsemalAKye, kujaSaSidivase, janmatArAsu cATa । nAqInakzatrahIne, gururavirajanInATatArAdiSudDO, prAtaH kAryyA parIkzA dvitanucaragfhAMSodaye Sastalagne” । jyotize “siMhasTe makarasTe ca jIve cAstamite taTA । siMhasTe tu ravO nEva parIkzA Sasyate buDEH” । gargaH “dAhe diSAYcEva DarAprakampe, vajraprapAte'Ta vidAraRe vA । DUme, taTA pAMSukaraprapAte na kArayenmANgalikAdi kAryyam । ulkApAte ca nirGAte taTEvAkAlavarzaRe । Cidre sUryye vinirddizwe naM kuryyAnmaNgalakriyAm । DUmaketO samutpanne, grahaRe candrasUryyaryAH । grahARAM saNkare cEva na kuryyAnmaNgalakriyAm । dvisUryyaM vA trisUryyaM vA dfzwvA gaganamaRqalam । rAtrOSakraDanuScEva maNgalAni vivarjayet । digdAhedinamekaYca grahe sapta dinAni ca । BUmikampe ca samBUte tryahARi parivarjayet । ulkApAte ca tritayaM, DUme paYca dinAni ca । vajrapAte dinamekaMvarjayet sarvakarmmasu” । BojarAjaH “grahe ravIndvoravaniprakampe ketUdgamolkApatanAdidorza । vrate daSAhAni vadanti tajjYAntrayodaSAhAni vadanti kecit” । grahaRakAle BUkampolkApAtavajrapAtAdidozasamAhAre trayodaSAhamaSudDam kiYcidUnatatsamAhAre daSAham । grahaRAdyekEkadoze tryahamiti vAcaspatimiSrAH । atra smftisAgaraDftasArasaMgrahe “rAjyAdikamahAsidDO yajYadAnatapaHsu ca । hAmaKADyAyayoScEva varjayeddaSarAtrakam । lakzahome mahAdAne varjayet somake maKe । tapaHsvADyAyayoScEva cirAramBe trayodaSa” iti vyavasTA anyatra “ulkApAte BuvaH kampe akAlavarzagarjite । vajraketUdgamotpAte grahaRe candrasUryyayoH । prayARantu tyajet kzattraH saptarAtramataH param । brAhmaRaH kzattriyo vESyastyajet karmma trirAtrakam । SUdrastyaktvA cEkarAtraM sarvakarma samAcaret” । parASaraH “prayARe saptarAtraM syAt trirAtraM vratabanDane । ekarAtraM parityajya kuryyAt pARigrahaM grahe” । BfguH “kampe rAjani saptAhaM brAhmaRAnAM tryahantaTA । SUdrasyArdDadinaM proktaM sarvakAryyezu vE BfguH” । SUdrasyApadvizayam । kampEtyupalakzaRam । grahaRAdAvapyevamevAnyatrEkatra paWitatvAt । BojadevavyavahArasamuccaye “sarvaM kAryyaM ga kurvvIta gurO siMhe'stage'pi ca । vratadIkze na kurvvIta tamoyukte vfhaspatO” । tamoyukte rAhuyukte । vratadIkze iti nityetarakarmmopalakzaRam । taTAca smftisAgarasAre jyotizam “ekarASO sTitO syAtAM yadi rAhuvfhaspatI । vivAhavratayajYAdi sarvantatra vivarjayet” । malamAsAdyupakramya Bavizye “fkzaBede'pyekarASO samparko yadi vA'nayoH । gurorAhorapi taTA tyajedvidvAnna saMSayaH” । atra gurorlajjitatvaM hetuH । tadyaTA “yatra tatra sTito jIvastamoyogena lajjate । upahAsAya kiM na syAdasatsaNgo manIziRAm” iti । “anizwe triviDotpAte siMhikAsUnudarSane । saptarAtraM na kurvvIta yAtrodvAhAdimaNgalam” । iti dopikAyAmanizwEtyaBiDAnAt anizwajanakotpAta eva sarvakarmmAnaDikAraH । pUrvaliKitaBojarAjavacane'pi “ketUlkApatanAdidoze, iti dozajanaka eva taToparAge maRqalataH SuBe'pi yAtrAnizeDAya siMhikAsuta iti pfTagupAdananam । atra vivAhAdAvapi saptarAtranizeDAt parASaroktasvalpakAlanizeDa ApadvizayaH । tenAnizwAjanake BUmikampAdO na dozaH । ataeva vfhatsaMhitAyAM varAheRa utpAtaprakaraRe prAyaHpadamaBihitam taTA ca” yaH prakftiviparyyAsaH prAyaH saMkzepataH sa utpAtaH । kzitivyomadivyajAtoyaTottaraM gurutaro Bavati” prAyEti ftvAdiprayuktaviparyyAsavyAvfttyarTaM yadAha tatrEva “ye ca na dozaM janayantyutpAtAstAn ftusvaBAvakftAn । fziputtrEH kftEH SlokErvidyAdetEH samAsoktEH” manunApi “nirGAte BUmicalane jyotizAYcopasarpaRe । etAnAkAlikAn vidyAdanaDyAyAnftAvapi” । atrAnaDyayanArTamftAvapotyuktam । utpAte dozaBaNgamAha SrIpativyavahAranibanDe “aTa divasatrayamaDye mfdujalapatanaM yadA syAt । tadotpAtadozaM SamayedityAhurAcAryyAH” vArhaspatye “SamayantyAsaptAhAt kampAdikftaM nimittamASveva । ativarzaRopabAsavratadokzAjapyahavanAni” । vizRuDarmottare “Sete'tra caturonAsAn yAvadBavati kArttikaH । viSizwA na pravarttante tadA yajYAdikAH kriyAH । nABizecyo nfpaScEtre nADimAse kadAcana । na supte ca taTA kfzRe viSezAt mpavfzi dvija!” । Bavizyottare “supte mayi jagannATe keSave garuqaDvaje । nivarttante kriyAH sarvAScAturvarRyasya BArata! । vivAhabratabanDAdicUqAsaMskAradIkzaRam । yajYagfhapraveSAdidAnArccanapratizWanam । puRyAni yAni karmmARi varjayeddakziRAyane” । sarvAstattadvAkyagaRitAH pUrvaprAtisvikoktAH evaM pupayAnIti anyaTA viSezavacanavETarTyA dati vadanti । BojarAjaH “vApo taqAgagfhagApuradevasadmapAsAdavArimaWakUpavivAhacEtyAt । karttuM yaTAgamaviGAnaviDirvaDAtrA proktastaTEva kaTayAmi samAsato'ham । supte harO prakawaSezaPaRopaDAne lakzmokarAbjaparimArjitapAdapadme । mIne ravO Danuzi cAstamite taTejye vAstukriyAviDirasO muniBirnizidDaH” । ijyoguruH । nAradaH “vApIkUpataqAgAdipratizWAyajYakarma ca । na kuryyAtmalamAse ca mahAdAnavratAni ca” । dAnapadaM sAmAnyadAnaparamiti vadanti । taTAca smftiH ‘aste sanDyAgate bAle BfgO mAsi malimluce । devatAdarSanaM dAnaM mahAdAnaM vivarjayet’ । lazuhArItaH “BfgAvaste gurO siMhe gurvAditye malimluce । tyajet dAnaM mahAdAnaM vrataM devavilokanam” । etadvacanadvayaM kAlaviveke'pi । atra dAnamahAdAnayorupAdAnAt” ga॰ ta॰ । muhUrttacintAmaRipIyUzaDArAdO viSeza ukto vistaraBayAnnokta stataevAvaseyaH ।
m: कालाशुद्धि f. a season of ceremonial impurity (as at the birth of a child, the death of a relation, &c., when it is considered unlawful to perform any religious rites).

s: strI, (ajyate'nayA । anj + karaRe lyuw + NIp । kAlI aYjanI tataH puMvadBAvaH .) kzupaviSezaH । kAlikarpasikinI iti KyAtA । tatparyyAyaH । aYjanI 2 recanI 3 SilAYjanI 4 nIlAYjanI 5 kfzRABA 6 kAlI 7 kfzRAYjanI 8 । asyA guRAH । kawutvam । uzRatvam । amalatvam । kfmiSoDanatvam । apAnAvartta Samanatvam । jAWarAmayanASitvaYca । iti rAjanirGaRwaH ॥
v: strI ajyate anayA anja--karaRe--lyuw NIp kAlI aYjanI puMvadBAvaH । recanyAM kzupaBede rAjani॰
m: कालाञ्जनी f. a small shrub (used as a purgative), L.

v: na॰ kAlamaYjanam । kfzRavarRRADikyayukte aYjanaBede (kAjala) “na cakzuzoH kAntiviSezabudDyA kAlAYjanaM maNgalamityupAttam” kumA॰ ।

m: कालादर्श m. ‘the mirror of time’, N. of wk.
कालादिक m. (scil. मास) the month Caitra, L.

s: puM, (kAlaH sarvvasaMhArakaH agniH । pralayAgniH । yaTA mahABArate 1 । 54 । 25 । “brahmadaRqaM mahAGoraM kAlAgnisamatejasam । nASayizyAmi mA'tra tvaM BayaM kArzIH kaTaYcana” ॥ tadaDizwAtfrudradevasya priyatvAt paYcamuKarudrAkzo'pi kAlAgninABnAKyAyate .) paYcamuKarudrAkzaH । yaTA skAnde । “paYcavaktraH svayaM rudraH kAlAgnirnAma nAmataH । agamyAgamanAYceva aBakzyasya ca BakzaRAt । mucyate sarvvapApeByaH paYcavakvrasya DAraRAt” ॥ iti tiTyAditattvam ॥
v: pu॰ kAlaH sarvahiMsako'gniH । 1 pralayAgnO । kAlAnalapraBftayo'pyatra 2 tadaDizWAtari rudre 3 tatpriye paYca muKe rudrAkze । “paYcavaktraH svayaM rudraH kAlAgninAma nAmataH । agamyAgamanAccEva aBakzyasya ca BakzaRAt । mucyate sarvapApe'ByaH paYcavaktrasya DAraRAt” ti॰ ta॰ skandapu॰ rudraparatve kAlarudraSabde udA॰ dfSyam ।
m: कालाग्नि m. the fire that is to destroy the world, conflagration at the end of time
कालाग्नि—भैरव n. N. of a Tantra

s: puM, (kAlaH saMhArakaH agniH sambarttakAgnirityarTaH । tasyADizWAtA rudraH । kAlAgni riva rudro vA .) saMhArakArirudraH । yaTA । kAlAgnirudra fzirityAdi vEdikasanDyAyAM rudropasTAnam ॥ * ॥ tadvivaraRaM yaTA, -- Sakra uvAca । “BagavaMstava vAkyAnAM na tfptirBavate mama । kAlAgnipArTivaM mAnaM SrotumicCAmi tattvataH” ॥ BagavAnuvAca । “na hi pArTivadvIpezu merupfzWe'pi vAsava ! । BogAhlAdakarA nFRAM taTA pAtAlavAsizu ॥ yezu naH kAlarudrasya nAnAstrISatasaMkulA । vicitraharmmyavinyAsA kutaste merupfzwataH ॥ sA eva kAlarudrasya tanurupeRa saMsTitA । sA parASivaBAvena paramApadadAyikA ॥ tasyA yadduHsahaM tejo brahmAdInAM kzayaM karam । taM vidDi kAlarudreti sOmyarUpaM sadASivam ॥ kAlAgnivyasanaM lakzaM yojanAnAM pramARataH । ardDenocCrayatastasya pAdAH pAdena vAsava ! ॥ siMharUpA mahAGorA mahAnakrA mahAbalAH । kAlAgnirudrarUpo yo bahurUpasamAvftaH ॥ anantapadmarUpaSca DAtAraH kAraReSvaraH । dAruRAgniSca rudraSca yamahantA kzamAntakaH ॥ lohitaH krUratejAtmA Gano vfzwirbalAhakaH । vidyutaScalaSIGraSca prasannaH SAntasOmyadfk ॥ sarvvajYo viviDo budDo dyutimAn dIptisupraBaH । ete rudrA mahAtmAnaH kAlikASaktivfMhitAH ॥ saMharanti samastedaM brahmAdyaM sacarAcaram । kAlAgniBuvanISo'yaM bahukowiBirAvftaH ॥ tasyAH purasya vistAraM SatakowisuvarttulA । devaganDarvvasidDAnAM tatra BogAH sudurllaBAH ॥ pUrvvottaraparA paNktiryAmyottarasTitA parA । analAnilaparA ca nErftISAnagAparA ॥ etezAM maDyato rAjan kAlarudrastu SoBane । paNktyAkArEH purEH sarvvaM kawakaM tasya saMsTitam ॥ samantAdvezwitavanaM prAkArAwwAlagopurEH । vajrendranIlavEdUryyEH prAkArEH sarvvato'nvitam ॥ kAlAgninarakAnte tu puraM kAlasya saMsTitam । paYcASallakzavistAraM samantAt parivarttulam ॥ jAmbUnadamayErhemEH KacitaM ratnaDAtuBiH ॥ pramadAjanasaMjuzwaM nAnAvarRasamAvftam ॥ kAmonmattapramattaSca tadBAti janasaMkulam । kAlasya BuvanaM divyaM vfttAkAraM manoharam ॥ vezwitaM hemaprAkArEryojanAyutamucCritam । prAkArAvahidaRqAnte antaraM yojanAyutam ॥ agnijvAlESca niviqErBayadEH kiMSukapraBEH । haritAlaniBA jvAlA sindUragErikApraBA ॥ ata urdDvaM prajajvAla vAtodDUtAgniBAsvarA । vIcitaraNgakallolajvAlAmAlAkulAmbarA ॥ pravfttAstAH pramARena yojanadvayakowayaH । azwAnavatilakzARi jvAlA UrdDvantataH SilA ॥ vajraBUtA sadA taptA tasya tejoniyAmikA । catvAri kowimAnena kAraRena tu sTApitA ॥ tasyArdDena Bavet kiYcit kowyaScatvAri vAsava ! । evaM kAlAgnirudrasya mAhAtmyaM kIrttitaM mayA ॥ SravaRAt sarvvapApAni SAmyanti kAlajAnyapi” ॥ ityAdye devIpurARe kAlAgnirudrapurakaTanam ॥ (kfzRayajurvvedagatopanizadviSezaH । yaTA, muktikopanizadi । “kAlAgnirudramEtreyI suvAlakzari mantrikA” ॥ vawikOzaDaviSezaH । yaTA, -- “sUtakAntABralOhAnAM BasmamAkzikaganDakam । BUDarAKye puwe paScAddinEkaM tadvipAcayet ॥ daSamAMSaM vizaM yojyaM mAzamAtraYca Bakzayet । rasaH kAlAgnirudro'yaM daSAhena visapenut” ॥ kAlAgnirudrorasaH ॥ iti rasendrasArasaMgrahe vIsarpADikAre ॥ * ॥)
v: pu॰ kAlAgniriva rudraH । sarvahArake pralayAgnitulye rudre tamaDikftyEva kAlAgnirudropanizat pravfttA । aBedopacArAt tadupAsake 2 fziBede vEdika mantrARAM bahUnAM taddfzwatvAt tadArzatvam kAtyA॰ sarvAnukramikAyAmuktam ।

कालाग्नि—रुद्र-तीर्थ n. N. of a Tīrtha, ŚivP.
कालाग्नि—रुद्रोपनिषद् f. N. of several Upaniṣads.

s: klI, (kAlaM kfzRaM aguru .) kfzRAguru । ityamaraH । 2 । 6 । 127 ॥ (yaTA raGuH 4 । 81 । “cakampetIrRalOhitye tasmin prAgjyotizeSvaraH । tadgajAlAnatAM prAptEH saha kAlAgurudrumEH” ॥ kfzRAguruSabde'sya paryyAyaH guRAScajYeyAH ॥)
v: na॰ karma॰ । kfzRAguruRi amaraH tadguRAdi BAvapra॰ uktaM yaTA “aguru pravaraM lohaM rAjArhaM yogajaM taTA । baMSikaM kfmijaM cApi kfmijagDamanAryyakam । agurUzRaM kawu tvacyaM tiktaM tIkzRaYca pittalam । laGu karRAkzirogaGnaM SItavAtakaPapraRut । kfzRaM guRADikaM tattu lOhavadvAri majjati । agurupraBavaH snehaH kfzRAgurusamaH smftaH” । tadutpattideSaSca prAgjyotizadeSaH yaTAha raGO “cakambe tIrRalOhitye tasmin prAgjyotizeSvaraH । tadgajAlAnatAM prAptEH saha kAlAgurudrumEH” ।
m: कालागुरु m. (n., L.) a kind of black aloe wood or Agallochum, MBh.; R. &c.

कालाकाङ्क्षिन् mfn. expecting (quietly) the coming time, R.; Kathās. cvii, 8.

काला-मुख See 1. काल.

v: pu॰ kAlaHsarvvasaMhArakaH analaH । 1 pralayAgnO “daMzwrAkarAlAni ca te muKAni dfzwvEva kAlAnalasanniBAni” gItA । 2 nfpaBede “saBAnaraScAkzuzaSca parame kzustaTEva ca । saBAnarasya putrastu vidvAn kAlAnalo nfpaH । kAlAnalasya DarmmajYaH sfYjayonAma viSrutaH । sfYjayasyA Bavat putro vIrorAjA puraYjayaH” । harivaM॰ 31 a॰

of another man

v: na॰ kAlAnala iva hiMsakaM cakram । narapatijayacaryyokte'nizwAdijYApake cakraBede tadBedAdikaYca cakraSabde vakzyate ।

m: कालानल—रस m. N. of a medical drug.

कालान्तक m. time regarded as the god of death, MBh. iii, 11500; R.
कालान्तक—यम m. all-destroying time in the form of Yama, MBh. iii; R.
कालान्त˚रात् ind. after some time, MBh.; Pañcat.

the proper time or season for (gen. dat. loc., in comp., inf., or Pot. with यद्, e.g. कालः प्रस्थानस्य or ˚नाय or ˚ने, time for departure; क्रिया-काल, time for action, Suśr.; नायं कालो विलम्बितुम्, this is not the time to delay, Nal.; कालो यद् भुञ्जीत भवान्, it is time for you to eat, Pāṇ. iii, 3, 168, Kāś.), ŚBr.; MBh. &c.

a section, part, VPrāt.
the end, ChUp.

time (as leading to events, the causes of which are imperceptible to the mind of man), destiny, fate, MBh.; R. &c.

time (as destroying all things), death, time of death (often personified and represented with the attributes of Yama, regent of the dead, or even identified with him: hence कालम्-√ इ or कालं-√ कृ, ‘to die’, MBh. &c.; काल in this sense is frequently connected with अन्तक, मृत्यु, e.g. अभ्य्-अधावत प्रजाः काल इवान्तकः, ‘he attacked the people like Time the destroyer’, R. iii, 7, 9; cf. कालान्तक; काल personified is also a Devarṣi in Indra's court, and a son of Dhruva, MBh. i, 2585; Hariv.; VP.)
काल [cf. κήρ; Lat. calen-doe: Hib. ceal, ‘death and everything terrible’.]
a: काल — a. (ली f.) 1 Black, of a dark or dark-blue colour. --2 Injuring, hurting. --लः 1 The black or dark-blue colour. --2 Time (in general); विलंबितफलैः कालं निनाय स मनोरथैः R. 1. 33; तस्मिन्काले at that time; काव्यशास्त्रविनोदेन कालो गच्छति धीमतां H. 1. the wise pass their time &c. --3 Fit or opportune time (to do a thing), proper time or occasion; (with gen., loc., dat., or inf.); R. 3. 12, 4. 6, 12. 69; पर्जन्यः कालवर्षी Mk. 10. 60. --4 A period or portion of time (as the hours or watches of a day); षष्ठे काले दिवसस्य V. 2. 1; Ms. 5. 153. --5 The weather. --6 Time considered as one of the nine dravyas by the Vaiśeṣikas. --7 The Supreme spirit regarded as the destroyer of the universe, being a personification of the destructive principle; कालः काल्या भुवनफलके क्रडिति प्राणिशारैः Bh. 3. 39. --8 (a) Yama, the god of death; कः कालस्य न गोचरांतरगतः Pt. 1. 146. (b) Death, time of death. --9 Fate, destiny. --10 The black part of the eye. --11 The (Indian) cuckoo. --12 The planet Saturn. --13 N. of Śiva. --14 A measure of time (in music or prosody). --15 A person who distils and sells spirituous liquor. --16 A section, or part --17 A red kind of plumbago. --18 Resin, pitch --19 N. of an enemy of Śiva. --20 (with the Jainas) One of the nine treasures. --21 A mystical name for the letter म्. --ला 1 N. of several plants. --2 N. of a daughter of Dakṣa. --3 An epithet of Durgā. --ली 1 Blackness. --2 Ink, black ink. --3 An epithet of Pārvatī, Śiva's wife. --4 A row of black clouds. --5 A woman with a dark complexion. --6 N. of Satyavatī, mother of Vyāsa. --7 Night. --8 Censure, blame. --9 One of the seven tongues of Fire. --10 A form of Durgā; कालीतनयः a buffalo. --11 One of the Mātṛs or divine mothers. --12 N. of a wife of Bhīma. --13 A sister of Yama. --14 A kind of learning (महाविड्या). --15 A small shrub used as a purgative. --लं 1 Iron. --2 A kind of perfume. --Comp. --अयसं iron. --अक्षरिकः a scholar, one who can read and decipher. --अगरु n. a kind of sandal tree, black kind of aloe; Bv. 1. 70, R. 4. 81. (--n.) the wood of that tree; Rs. 4. 5; 5. 5. --अग्निः, --अनलः {1} the destructive fire at the end of the world. {2} an epithet of Rudra. {3} a kind of bead (रुद्राक्ष). --अंग a. having a dark-blue body (as a sword with a dark-blue edge). --अजिनं the hide of a black antelope. --अंजनं a sort of collyrium; Ku. 7. 20, 82. --(नी) a small shrub used as a purgative. --अंडजः the (Indian) cuckoo. --अतिक्रमः --मणं delay, being late; Pt. 1. 154. --अतिपातः, --अतिरेकः loss of time, delay; Māl {2} --अतीत a. elapsed, passed by. --अत्ययः {1} delay, lapse of time. {2} loss by lapse of time. --अध्यक्षः {1} ‘presiding over time’, epithet of the sun. {2} the Supreme soul. --अनुनादिन् m. {1} a bee. {2} a sparrow. {3} the Cātaka bird. --अनुसारकः {1} Tagara tree. {2} yellow sandal. --अनुसारिः, --अनुसारिन्, --अनुसारिवा, --अनुसार्यः, --र्यकः benzoin. --अंतकः time, regarded as the god of death, and the destroyer of every thing. --अंतरं {1} an interval. {2} a period of time. {3} another time or opportunity. ˚आवृत a. hidden or concealed in the womb of time. ˚क्षम a. able to bear delay; अकालक्षमा देव्याः शरीरावस्था K. 263; Ś. 4. ˚प्रेक्षिन् Pt. 3. 172. ˚विषः an animal venomous only when enraged, as a rat. --अभ्रः a dark, watery cloud. --अवधिः appointed time. --अवबोधः knowledge of time and circumstances; Māl. 3. 11. --अशुद्धिः f., --अशौचं period of mourning, ceremonial impurity caused by the birth of a child or death of a relation in the family; see अशौच. --आकृष्ट a. {1} led to death. {2} produced or brought by time. --आत्मक a. depending on time or destiny. --आत्मन् m. the Supreme spirit. --आयसं iron. --उप्त a. sown in due season. --कंजं a blue lotus. --कटंकटः an epithet of Śiva. --कंठः {1} a peacock. {2} a sparrow. {3} a wagtail. {4} a gallinule. {5} an epithet of Śiva; U. 6. --कंठकः --कंटकः a gallinule. --कंडकः a water-snake. --करणं appointing or fixing time. --कर्णिका, --कर्णी misfortune. --कर्मन् n. death. --कलायः dark pulse. --कल्प a. fatal, deadly. --कालः Supreme being. --कीलः noise. --कुंठः Yama. --कुष्ठः a myrrh. --कूटः, --टं (a) a deadly poison; Ś. 6. (b) the poison churned out of the ocean and drunk by Śiva; अद्यापि नोज्झति हरः किल कालकूटं Ch. P. 50. --कृत् m. {1} the sun. {2} a peacock. {3} Supreme spirit. --कृत {1} produced by time. {2} fixed, appointed. {3} lent or deposited. {4} done for a long time. --(तः) the sun. --क्रमः lapse of time, course of time; कालक्रमेण in course or process of time; Ku. 1. 19. --क्रिया {1} fixing a time. {2} death. --क्षेपः {1} delay, loss of time; Me. 22; मरणे कालक्षेपं माकुरु Pt. 1. {2} passing the time. --खंजं, --खंजनं, --खंडं the liver. --गंगा the river Yamunā. --ग्रांथिः a year. --घातिन् a. killing by degrees or slowly (as a poison) --चक्रं {1} the wheel of time (time being represented as a wheel always moving). {2} a cycle. {3} (hence fig.) the wheel of fortune, the vicissitudes of life. --(क्रः) an epithet of the sun. --चिह्नं a symptom of approaching death. चोदित a. summoned by the angel of death. --ज्येष्ठ a. senior in years, grown up; U. 5. 12. --ज्ञ a. knowing the proPer time or occasion (of any action); अत्यारूढो हि नारीणामकालज्ञो मनोभवः R. 12. 33; Śi. 2. 83. --(ज्ञः) {1} an astrologer. {2} a cock. --ज्ञानिन् m. an epithet of Śiva. --त्रयं the three times; the past, the present, and the future; ˚दर्शी K. 46. --दंडः death. --दमनी an epithet of Durgā. --धर्मः, --धर्मन् m. {1} the line of conduct suitable to any particular time. {2} the law or rule of time. {3} effects proper to the time. {4} fated time, death; न पुनर्जीवितः कश्चित्कालधर्ममुपागतः Mb.; परीताः कालधर्मणा &c. --धारणा prolongation of time. --नरः (in astrology) the figure of a man's body. --नाथः, --निधिः Śiva. --नियोगः decree of fate or destiny; लंध्यतेन खलु कालनियोगः Ki. 9. 13. --निरूपणं determination of time, chronology. --नेमिः {1} the rim of the wheel of time. {2} N. of a demon, uncle of Rāvaṇa, deputed by him to kill Hanūmat. {3} N. of a demon with 100 hands killed by Viṣṇu. ˚अरिः, रिपुः, हरः, हन् m. epithets of Kṛṣṇa. --पक्व a. ripened by time, i. e. spontaneously; Ms. 6. 17, 21; Y. 3. 49. --परिवासः standing for a time so as to become stale. --पाशः the noose of Yama or death. --पाशिकः a hangman. --पृष्ठं {1} a species of antelope. {2} a heron. --(कं) {1} N. of the bow of Karṇa; Ve. 4. {2} a bow in general. --प्रभातं autumn or Śarad; (the two months following the rainy season considered as the best time). --भक्षः an epithet of Śiva. --भृत् m. the sun. --भैरवः an epithet of Śiva. --मानं a measure of time. --मुखः a species of ape. --मेषी f. the Manjiṣṭha plant. --यवनः a king of Yavanas and enemy of Kṛṣṇa and an invincible foe of the Yādavas. Kṛṣṇa, finding it impossible to vanquish him on the field of battle, cunningly decoyed him to the cave where Mucukunda was sleeping who burnt him down. --यापः, --यापनं procrastination, delay, putting off. --योगः fate, destiny. ˚तः according to the requirements of the time; Pt. 1. 184. --योगिन् m. an epithet of Śiva. --रात्रिः, --रात्री f. {1} a dark night. {2} a sister of Yama. {3} the Amāvasyā on which lamps are lighted (in the Divālī holidays). {4} the night of destruction at the end of the world (identified with Durgā). {5} a particular night in the life of man, on the 7th day of the 7th month of the 77th year. --लोहं --लौहं steel. --विप्रकर्षः prolongation of time. --वृद्धिः f. periodical interest (payable monthly, quarterly, or at stated times); Ms. 8. 153. --वेला the time of Saturn, i. e. a particular time of the day (half a watch every day) at which any religious act is improper. --संकर्षा a girl {9} years old personating Durgā at a festival. --संरोधः {1} keeping back for a long time; Ms. 8. 143. {2} lapse of a long period of time. --सदृश a. opportune, timely. --संपन्न a. dated, bearing a date. --सर्पः the black and most poisonous variety of the snake. --सारः the black antelope. --(रं) a yellow sort of sandal wood. --सूत्रं, --सूत्रकं {1} thread of time or death. {2} N. of a particular hell; Y. 3. 222; Ms. 4. 88. --स्कंदः the Tamāla tree. --स्वरूप a. terrible as death, (deathlike in form). --हरः an epithet of Śiva. --हरणं loss of time, delay; Ś. 3; U. 5; Mv. 4. 41. --हानिः f. delay; R. 13. 16.

k.v: कालो दण्डधरः श्राद्धदेवो वैवस्वतोऽन्तकः। राक्षसः कौणपः क्रव्यात्क्रव्यादोऽस्रप आशरः॥
कालो दिष्टोऽप्यनेहापि समयोऽप्यथ पक्षतिः।  प्रतिपद्द्वे इमे स्त्रीत्वे तदाद्यास्तिथयो द्वयोः॥
कृष्णे नीलासितश्यामकालश्यामलमेचकः। पीतो गौरो हरिद्राभः पलाशो हरितो हरित्.।

s: strI, (kAlaBAyE kfzRapraBAyE aRqati udyacCati । aqi + Rvul wAp itvaYca .) maYjizwA । iti rAjanirGaRwaH ॥
v: strI kAlaBAyE kfzRapraBAyE aRqati aqiudyame Rvul । maYjizWAyAM rAjani॰ tasyA raktaniryAsavattve'pi klATanAt pUrvvaM kfzRakARqatvAttaTAtvam ।
m: काल—भाण्डिका f. Rubia Munjista, L.
काल—भाग m. a degree of time, Sūryas.

v: pu॰ BIrorBAvaH aR BEravaM BIrutvaM kAlasya BEravaM BayaM yasmAt । kASIsTe SivAMSaje BErava Bede saca SivatattvajYAnaviGurabrahmaRaHpaYcamaSiraSCedanAya Siyena prAdurBAvitaH । tatkaTAdi kASIKa॰ 32 a॰ । tadvAkyaYca kapAlamocanaSabde 1655 pf॰ darSitam । tannAmaniruktistatrEva darSitA yaTA “tvatto Bezyati kAlo'pi tatastu kAlaBEravaH” । kAlarAjo'pyatra tatrEva tannAmanirukti rdarSitA yaTA “kAlavadrAjase yasmAt kAlarAjastato BavAn । tasya ca kASyAmADipatyaM tatrEvoktaM yaTA “ADipatyaYca tasyAM te kAlarAja! sadEva hi । tatra ye pApakarttArastezAM SAstA tvamevahi । SuBASuBaM na tatkarmma citragupto liKizyati ॥ etAn varAn pragfhyATa tatkzaRAt kAlaBEravaH । vAmANgulinaKAgreRa cakartta ca SirIviDeH”
m: काल—भैरव m. a form of Bhairava.
काल—भक्ष m. ‘time-devourer’, N. of Śiva.
काल—भेद m. N. of wk.
काल—भृत् m. (cf. -कृत्), the sun, L.
काल—भोगिन् m. Coluber Naga, Daś.
काल—धारणा f. ‘prolongation of time’, a pause, RPrāt.
काल—धर्म m. the law or rule or operation of time, death, dying, MBh.; Hariv.; R.
line of conduct suitable to any time or season
influence of time, seasonableness
effects suited to the time or season.

k.v: स्यात्पञ्चता कालधर्मो दिष्टान्तः प्रलयोऽत्ययः। अन्तो नाशो द्वयोर्मृत्युर्मरणं निधनोऽस्त्रियाम्.।

m: काल—धर्मन् m. the law or operation of time, death, MBh.; Hariv.

s: puM, (kAlasya DarmmaH । AyuzaH pariRAma kAle paYcatvaprAptirUpo DarmmaH .) mftyuH । ityamaraH । 2 । 8 । 116 ॥ samayasya svaBAvaH ॥ (yaTA, heH rAmAyaRe । 2 । 72 । 37 । “kAlaDarmmaparikziptaH pASEriva mahAgajaH” ॥)
v: pu॰ 6 ta॰ । 1 mftyOH amaraH aprAptavati tasmiMstu yOvanaM puruzarzaBe । sa rAjA SAntanuDIrman kAlaDarmamupeyivAn” BA॰ A॰ 102 a॰ । kAlasya ftuviSezasya DarmmaH 6 ta॰ । 2 samayasya svaBAve ftvAdikAlasya3 Darmme ca ।

pu॰ kAlasyeva hiMsASAlitayA Darmmo'sya anic samA॰ । mftyO । “sa pARquH kAlaDarmmaRA” BA॰ A॰ 124 a॰ । etAScEtA 1 prajAH sarvvAH dakzakanyAsu jajYire । kaSyapenAvyayeneha, saMyuktAH kAlaDarmmaRA” hari॰ 312 a॰ ।

m: काल—घातिन् mfn. (said of a poison) killing in the course of time (i.e. by degrees, slowly), Suśr.

v: pu॰ janamejayasarpasatre ArttvijyakArake brAhmaRaviSeze “AtreyaH kuRqajaWarodvijaH kAlaGawastaTA” BA॰ A॰ 53 a॰ ।
m: काल—घट m. N. of a Brahman, MBh. i, 2048.

s: klI, (kAlaM kfzRaM KaRqam .) yakft । dakziRakukzisTamAMsaKaRqam । ityamaraH । 2 । 6 । 66 ॥ (yakftSabde'sya viSezo jYAtavyaH ॥)
v: na॰ kAlaM kfzRaM KaRqam । dakziRakukzisTe mAMsaKaRqe amaraH । hemAdriDfte kAlapratipAdake granTaBede ca ।
m: काल—खण्ड n. id., Bālar.

k.v: अन्त्रं पुरीतद्गुल्मस्तु प्लीहा पुंस्यथ वस्नसा। स्नायुः स्त्रियां कालखण्डयकृती तु समे इमे॥

m: काल—खण्ड—हन् m. N. of Arjuna, L.

v: pu॰ dAnavaBede “saMhrAdo vipracittiSca kAlaKaYjASca dAnavAH” BA॰ sa॰ 9 a॰ varuRasaByakIrttane ।
m: काल—खञ्ज m. pl. = -कञ्ज, MBh. ii, iv
काल—खञ्ज n. the liver, L.

s: klI, (kAlena kAlAntareRa KaYjati vikftiM gacCatIti । kAla + Kaji + lyuH .) yakft । iti hemacandraH ॥
v: na॰ kAlena KaYjati Kaji--lyu । yakfti hfdayasTe raktADArasTAne hemaca॰ ।
m: काल—खञ्जन n. the liver, L.

a: कालंजरः — 1 N. of a mountain and adjacent country (modern Kallinjar). --2 An assembly of religious mendicants. --3 An epithet of Śiva. --रा or री An epithet of Durgā.

m: कालङ्कत m. the plant Cassia Sophora, Car. iii, 8.

s: puM, (kutsito'pi alaNkftaH IzadalaNkfto vA । koH kAdeSaH .) vfkzaviSezaH । kAlakAsunde iti BAzA । tatparyyAyaH । arimarddaH 2 kAsamarddaH 3 karkaSaH 4 । iti ratnamAlA ॥
v: pu॰ IzadalaNkftaH koH kA । (kAlakAse~dA) vfkzaBede ratnamA॰ ।

na॰ ni॰ karma॰ । svanAmaKyAte(naricA)hindI BAzAprasidDe SrAdDaSAke BAvapra॰ । “nAqikaM kAlaSAkaYca SrAdDaSAkaYca kAlakamiti” tatparyyAyamuktvA “kAlaSAkaM saraM rUkzaM vAtakft kaPaSoTahft । balyaM rucikaraM meDyaM raktapittaharaM himam” tatguRAdyuktam । rucyaM rucaye dIptaye hitamityarTaH । meDyaM SrAdDadeyatvena pavitram yaTAha hArItaH “kAlaSAkaYca vAstUkaM mUlakaM kfzRanAlikAm । vetrANkuraM kalAyaYca (mawara) pawolaM sarzapaM taTA । sUryyAvarttaM sunizaRRaM SAkAnyAhurmanIziRaH” ।
m: काल—शाक n. the potherb Ocimum sanctum, Mn. iii, 272; MBh. &c.
Corchorus capsularis, L.

s: puM, (kAlaH kfzRaH SAliH utkfzwaDAnyaviSezaH .) kfzRaSAliH । iti rAjanirGaRwaH ॥
v: pu॰ ni॰ karma॰ । kfzRavrIhO DAnyaBede rAjani॰ kfzRavrIhi--SAlAmuKa--jatumuKa--nandImuKa--lAvAkzaka--tvaritaka--kukkuwARqaka--pArAvatakapAwapraBftayo vrIhayaH । kazAyamaDurAH pAke maDurA vIryyato himAH । alpABizyandinastulyAH zazwikErbadDavarcasaH । kfzRavrIhirvarastezAM kazAyAnu raso laGuH । tasmAdalpAntaraguRAH kramaSo vrIhayo'pare । dagDAyAmavanO jAtAH SAlayo laGupAkinaH । kazAyA badDaviRmUtrA rUkzAH SlezmApakarzaRAH” suSrutaH । tallakzaRamuktaM BAvapra॰ kfzRabrIhiH sa vijYeyoyaH kfzRatuzataRqulaH” ।
m: काल-शालि m. a black kind of rice, L.

v: pu॰ ni॰ karmma॰ । parvataBede tatsTAnAdi BA॰ va॰139 a॰ “uktaM yaTA “uSIravIjaM mEnAkaM giriM SvetaYca BArata! । samatIto'si kOnteya । kAlaSElaYca pArTiva! । ezA gaNgA saptaviDA rAjate BaratarzaBa! । sTAnaM virajasaM puRyaM yatrAgnirnityamiDyate । etadvE mAnuzeRAdya na SakyaM drazwumadButam । samADiM kurutAvyagrAstIrTAnyetAni drakzyaTa । etaddfSyati devAnAmAkrIqaYcaraRANkitam । atikrAnto'si kOnteya! kAlaSElaYca parvatam” ।
m: काल—शैल m. N. of a mountain, MBh. iii, 10820 ff.
काल—शक्ति f. the Śakti of all-destroying time, Vcar.
काल—शम्बर m. N. of a Dānava, Hariv. 9210.

s: klI, (kalaSyAM Bavam । kalaSI + Qak .) kAlaseyam । Golam । ityamarawIkAyAM BarataH ॥
m: कालशेय n. (fr. कलशि, Pāṇ. iv, 3, 56), buttermilk, Daś.
a: कालशेयं — Buttermilk(produced in a jar by churning).

k.v: दण्डाहतं कालशेयमरिष्टमपि गोरसः। तक्रं ह्युदश्विन्मथितं पादाम्ब्वर्धाम्बु निर्जलम्.।

m: काल—शिबि m. N. of a man, Pravar.
कालञ्जरा f. N. of Durgā, L.

s: strI, (kAlaM jarayati । kAla + jF + Ric + ac । mftyuYjayaH tasya patnI NIp .) caRqI । iti DaraRI ॥ (svayameva kAlaM jarayatIti vyutpattyA wAveva .) tadA kAlaYjarA iti rUpAntaram ॥
m: कालञ्जरी f. id., L.

s: puM, (kAlaM jarayati । kAla + jF + Ric + ac । bAhulakAt mum .) yogicakramelakam । (kAlaM mftyuM jarayatIti .) BEravaH । (kAlena jIryyati । jF + ac .) parvvataviSezaH । iti medinI ॥ (yaTA, mahABArate 3 । tIrTayAtrAparvvaRi 85 । 56 । “atra kAlaYjaraM nAma parvvataM lokaviSrutam । tatra devahrade snAtvA gosasraPalaM laBet” ॥) deSaviSezaH । iti DaraRI ॥
v: pu॰ kAlaM jarayati jf--Ric--ac bA॰ mum । parvataBede “sapta vyADA daSArRezu mfgAH kAlaYjare girO” BAra॰ pitfkalpagATA । tanmAhAtmyaM BA॰ va॰ 85 a॰ “tatra kAlaYjaro nAma parvvato lokaviSrutaH । tatra devahrade snAtvA gosahasraPalaM laBet । yaH snAtastApayettatra girO kAlaYjare nfpaH । svargaloke mahIyeta naronAstyatra saMSayaH । tato girivaraSrezWe citrakUwe viSAmpate!” । tenAsyaM citrakUwaparvvatasAnniDyaM gamyate । tatra mAsaM kftastAne daSASvameDaPalaM yaToktam BA॰ anu॰ 35 a॰ gaNgAyamunayostIrTe taTA kAlaYjare girO । daSASvameDAnApnoti tatra mAsaM kftodakaH” । ayaYca BUmimaDyasTareKAtaH prAcyAM diSi varttata yaTA BA॰ va॰ 87 a॰ । “pUrvvaM prAcIM diSa rAjan! rAjarzigaRasevitAm” ityupakramya pUrvvadiksTatIrTakaTane “prayAgamiti viKyAtaM tasmAdBaratasattama! । agastyasya tu rAjendra! tatrASramavaro nfpa । tattaTA tApasAraRyaM tApasErupaSoBitam । hiraRyavinduH kaTito girO kAlaYjare mahAn” । ityukteH । tIrTaparatve asya klIvatvamapi । “kAlaYjaraM praBAsaYca taTA vadarikASramaH” iti kASI॰ BOmatIrTakaTane 6 a॰ taTAprayogAt । 2 yogicakramelake । 3 BEraDaBedemedi॰ । 4 deSaBede Dara॰ । sa ca kAlaYjaragirirUpajanapadAvaDiBUtaH । tato BavAdO ropaDatvAt prAgvarttitvAcca vuY । kAlaraYjaka tadBave tri॰ । kAlaM mftyuM jarayati jf--bA॰ Kac । 5 kAlasya mftyorjArake tri॰ । “indriyARAM hi sarvvezAM vaSyAtmA calitasmftiH । AtmanaH sampradAnena marttyomftyumuvASnute । Ahatya sarvasaNkalpAn satve cittaM niveSayet । satve cittaM samAveSya tataH kAlaYjaro Bavet” BA॰ SA॰ 24 a॰ । kAlaM mftyuM jarayati । mftyuYjaye 6 Sive tasya patnI NIp kAlaYjarI 7 caRqikAyAM strI Dara॰ । svayaM tajjArakatve tu wAbeveti BedaH ।

s: klI, (kAlasya kAlagateScakramiva .) kAlarUpacakram । yaTAha -- hemacandraH ॥ “kAlo dviviDo'vasarpiRyutsarpiRIzu BedataH । sAgarakowikowInAM viMSatyA sa samApyate ॥ avasarpiRyAM zaqarA utsarpiRyAM ta eva viparItAH । evaM dvAdaSaBirarErvivarttate kAlacakramidam” ॥ jyotiScakraviSezaH । yaTA, -- “trinABimati paYcAre zaRReminyakzayAtmake । sambatsaramaye kftsnaM kAlacakraM pratizWitam” ॥ iti vizRupurARe 2 । 8 । 4 । cakramevopAsanArTaM viSizyannAha । trinABimatIti । nABiH stamBaH yatrAkzaH protaH sa ca trimeKalaH । ahnaScAtra nABitvenopAsyatvAt meKalArUpAstisro nABayaH pUrvvAhRamaDyAhnAparAhRAstadyukte । paYcAre paYca saMvatsaraparivatsarAdayo vakzyamARA arAH SalAkA yasya saH tasmin । zaRRemini zaw ftavo nemayaH prAntabalayAni tadvati । kAlAtmakatvAdakzayAtmake । saMvatsaramaye saMvatsarAvayavamAsA ramBakatvAt saMvatsaratvenopAsyatvAcca tanmayam । taduktaM mAtsye । “ahastrinABiH sUryyasya tvekacakrasya vE smftam । arAH saMvatsarAH paYca nemyaH zaqftavaH smftAH” ॥ iti । tasmin kAlacakraM kAlopalakzaRaBUtaM kftsnaM jyotiScakraM pratizWitaM ASritam । sUryyagatyaDInatvAt kAlacakraPalasya । iti tawwIkAyAM SrIDarasvAmI ॥ (“sa eza nimezAdiyugaparyyantaH kAlaScakravat parivartta mAnaH kAlacakramucyata ityeke” ॥ iti suSrute sUtrasTAne 6 aDyAye ॥)
v: na॰ kAlasya kAlagateScakramiva । hemaca॰ ukte dvAdaSAre 1 kAlacakraBede । (utsarpin) Sabde 113 pf॰ vivftiH । kAlaScakramivAniSaM parivarttamAnatvAt । vizRupurARAdyukte jyotiScakrADizWite cakravatparivarttamAne 2 kAle । “yaTA kulAlacakreRa BramatA saha BramatAM tadASrayARAM pipIlikAdInAM gatiranyEva pradeSAntarepUpalaByamAnatvAt evaM nakzatrarASiBirupalakzitena kAlacakreRa DruvaM meruYca dakziRataH pariDAvatA saha pariDAvamAnAnAM tadASrayARAM sUryyAdInAM grahARAM gatiranyEva nakzatrAntare rASyantare copalaByamAnatvAt” । BAga॰ 5 22 9Slo । BA॰ va॰ 163 a॰ kalAkAzWAdiviBAgamuktA “evameza caran pArTa! kAlacakramatantritaH । vardDayan sumahAtejAH savitA parivarttate” prapaYcastu vizRupurARe yaTA “parASara uvAca । vyAKyAtametadbrahmARqasaMsTAnaM tava suvrata! । tataH pramARasaMsTAne sUryyAdInAM SfRuzva me । yojanAnAM sahasrARi dvitIyo'kzo vivasvataH । ISAdaRqastaTEvAsya dviguRo munisattama! । sArdDakowistaTA saptaniyutAnyaDikAni vE । yojanAnAntu tasyAkzastatra cakraM pratizWitam । trinABimati saYcAre zaRReminyakzayAtmake । saMvatsaramaye kftsnaM kAlacakraM pratizWitam । catvAriMSat sahasrARi dvitIyo'kzo vivasvataH । paYcApyanyAni sArdDAni syandanasya mahAmate! । akzapramARamuBayoH pramARaM taduyugArdDayoH । hrasvo'kzastatyugArdDaYca DruvADAraraTasya vE । dvitIye'kze tu taccakraM sTitaM vE mAnasAcale । hayASca sapta CandAMsi tezAM nAmAni me SfRu । gAyatrI ca vfhatyuzRigjagatI trizwubeva ca । anuzwup paNktirityetASCandAMsi harayo raveH । mAnasottaraSEle tu pUrvvato vAsavI purI! dakziRena yamasyAnyA pratIcyAM varuRasya vE । uttareRa tu somasya tAsAM nAmAni me SfRu । vasvekasArA Sakrasya, yAmyA saMyamanI smftA । purI suKA jaleSasya, somasya tu viBAvarI । kAzWANgato dakziRataH kziptezuriva BacCati । nEtreya! BagavAn BAnujyortizAM cakrasaM yutaH । ahorAtravyavasTAnakAraRaM BagavAn raviH । devayAnaparaH panTAyoginAM kleSasaMkzaye । divasasya ravirBaDye sarvvakAlaM vyavasTitaH । sarvva dvIpezu mEtreya! niSArdDasya ca sammuKaH । udayAstamanaYcEva sarvvakAlaYca sammuKe । diSAsu SezAsu taTA mEtreya! vidiSAsu ca । yEryatra dfSyate BAsvAn sa tezAmudayaH smftaH । tiroBAvaYca yatrEti yatra ca stamanaM raveH । nEvAztamanamarkasya nodayaH sarvvadA mataH । udayAstamanAKyaM hi darSanAdarSanaM raveH । SakrAdInAM pure tizWan spfSatyeza puratrayam । vikarRO dvO vikarRasTastrIllo~kAn dve pure taTA । uditovardDamAnABirAmaDyAhnAttapanraviH । tataHparaM hfsantIBirgoBirasta niyacCati । udayAstamanAByAYca smftaM pUrvvApare diSO । yAvat purastAttapati tAvat pfzWe ca pArSvataH । fte'marAsurErmerorupari brahmaRaH saBA । ye ye marIcayo'rkasya prayAnti brahmaRaH saBAm । te te nirastAstadBAsA pratIpamyuyAnti vE । tasyAM diSyuttarasyAM vE divArAtriH sadEva hi । sarvvezAM dvIparzARAM meruruttarato yataH । praBA vivasvato rAtrAvastaNgacCati BAskare । viSatyagnimatorAtrO vahnirekaH prakASate । vahnipAdastaTA BAnuM dinezvAviSati dvija! । atIva vahnisaMyogAdataH sUryyaH prakASate । tejasI BAskarAgneye prakASozRa svarUpiRI । parasparAnupraveSAdApAyyete divAniSam । dakziRottaraBUmyardDe samuttizWati BAskare । AtAmrAhi BavantyAponaktamahnaH praveSanAt । dinaM viSati cEvAmBo BAskare'stamupAgate । tasmAcCuklIBavantyApo naktamahnaH praveSanAt । evaM puzkaramaDyena yadA yAti divAkaraH । triMSadBAgAstu medinyAstadA mOhUrttikI gatiH । kulAla cakraparyyasto Bramanneva divAkaraH । karotyatastadA rAtriM bimuYcanmedinIM dvija! । ayanasyottrasyAdO makaraM yAti BAskaraH । tataH kumBaYca mInaYca rASe rASyantaraM dvija! । tezutezvaTa Buktezu tato vEzuvatIM gatim । prayAti savitA kurvvannahorAtraM tataH samam । tatorAtrikzayaM yAti vardDate ca dinaM dinam । tataSca miTunasyAnte paraM kAzWAmupAgataH । rASiM karkkawakaM prApya kurute dakziRAyanam । kulAlacakraparyyasto yaTA SIGraM pravarttate । dakziRe prakeame sUryyastaTA SIGraM pravarttate । ativegita yA kAlaM vAyuma rgavaSAccalan । tasmAt prakfzwAM BUmiYca kAlenAnyena gacCati । sUryyodvAQaSaBiHSEGyrAnmuhUrttErdakziRAyane । trayodaSArdDamfkzARAmahnAcarati vE dvija! । muhUrttEstAvadfkzARi naktamazwAdaSEScaran । kulAlacakamaDyasTo yaTA mandaM prasarpati । taTodagayane sUryyaH sarpate mandavikramaH । tasma ddIrGeRa kAlena sUmimalpantu gacCati । azwAdaSamuhUrttaM yaduttarAyaRapaScimam । aharBavati taccABicarate mandavikramaH । trayodaSArdDa mahrA tu fkzARAM carate raviH । muhUrttEstAvadfkzARi rAtrO dvAdaSaBiScaran । aDomandataraM nAByAM cakraM Bramati vE yaTA, mftpiRqavaccakramaDye Druvo Bavati vE taTA । kalAlacakranABistu yaTA tatrEva varttate । DruvastaTAhi mEtreya! taTEva parivarttate । uBayoH kAzWayormaDye BramatormaRqalAni tu । divA naktaYca sUryyasya mandA SIGrA ca vE gatiH । mandAhni yasminnayate SIGrA naktaM tadA gatiH । SIGrA niSi yadA sA ca tadA mandA divA gatiH । evaM pramARenEvEza mArgaM yAti divAkaraH । ahorAtreRa yoBa'Nkte samastA rASayo dvija । zaqevarASInyo BuNkterAtrAvacyAMSca zaqdivA । rASipramARajanitA hrasvadIrGAnvitA dvija! । taTA niSAyAM rASInAM pramARErlaGudIrGatA । dinAderdIrGahrasvatvaM tadBogenEa jAyate । uttame prakrame SarTrA niSi mandA gatirdivA । dakziRe tvayane cEva viparItA vivasvataH .” narapatijayacaryyokte caturaSIticakraBaDye 3 cakraBede tatsvarUpaM cakraSabde vakzyate । dAnArTakalpite hemA॰ dA॰ ukte rajatamaye 4 cakramede yaTA “cakra rOpyamayaM kftvA muktAraSmimayAtmakam । kftvA mUrdDniSaraccandraraSmimaDyAntarasTitam । tvaNmAMsAni tu rOpyARi gAtrezu ca samantataH । evaM DyAnavatastasta sa candraH kfzRatAM vrajet । tato'pyanantaraM paScAt sTitvA viprapradakziRam । taM gfhItvA vrajeddUramadfzwatvamapi vrajet । svayaYcAmftasaMvAGatapUrRakAyasTitisTitaH । kAlacakramidaM nAmrA dAnaM mftyuvinASanam । idante rAjataM cakraM raSmijAlasamAkulam । apanftyuvinASAya dadAmIti samuccaran । suvarRaM dakziRAyuktaM brAhmaRAya nivedayet । evaM kfte vinaSyeta apamftyurna saMSayaH । tatastasmAtsadA deyamapamftyuBayAnvitEH । jvarAdirogagrastErvA mahApatpatitErapi । tato gfhyoktaviDinA sTApayejjAtavedasam । juhuyAt kAlanAmnA tu SatamazwottarantilEH । tatastu BojayedBaktyA viprAn dvAdaSasaMKyayA । svayamakzAralavaRaM BuYjIta sakfdeva hi । evaM kfte narInUnaM ciraM jIvenna saMSayaH” ravyAdivAre nakzatrayogaBedAt 5 daRqaBede kAladaRqaSabde vivftiH ।

v: na॰ kAlasya mftyorjYApakaM cihnam । mftyujYApake lakzaRaBede । tallakzaRamuktaM kASIKa॰ 41 a॰ yaTA “vadAmi kAlacihnAni jAyante yAni dehinAm । mftyO nikawamApanne mune! tAni niSAmaya । dakzanAsA puwe yasya vAyurvAti dibAniSam । aKaRqamekaM tasyAyuH kzayatyabdatrayeRa hi । dvyahorAtraM tryahorAtraM ravirvahati santatam । sArdDEkadarzantasyeha jIvitAvaDirucyate । vahennAsApuwayuge daSAhAni nirantaram । vAtaScet sahasaMkrAntistayA jIveddinatrayam । nAsAvrtmadvayaM hitvA mAtariSvA muKAdvahet । saMSeddinatrayAdarvvAk prayARaM tasya cADva na । sUryye saptamarASisTe janmarkzasTe niSAcare । pOzRaH sa kAlo drazwavyo yadA yAmye ravirvahet । akasmAdeva tatkAle mftyuH sannihito mavet । vaYcanoyaH prayatnena sa kAlo mftyuBIruRA । akasmAdvIkzate yastu puruzaM kfzRapiNgalam । tasminneva kzaRe guptaM sajIvedvatsaradvayam । yasya vIjaM malaM mUtraM, kzutam mUtraM malantaTA । ihEkadA patedyasya abdantasyAyurizyate । indranIlaniBaM vyomni nAgavfndaM yaIkzate । itastataH prasfmaraM zaRmAsaM na sa jIvati । vyaBre'hni vAripUrRAsyaH pfzWIkftya divAkaram । PutkftyApsvindracApaYca paSyet zaRmAsajIvanaH । arunDartI DuvaYcEva vizRostrIRi padAni ca । AsannamftyurnopaSyeccaturTaM mAtfmaRqalam । arunDatI BavejjihvA bruvo nAsAgramucyate । vizRoH padAni BrUmaDye netrAgnO mAtfmaRqalam । vetti nIlAdivarRasya kawvamlAdirasasya hi । akasma danyaTABAvaM zaRmAsena sa mftyuBAk । zaRmAsa mftyorsatyesya kaRWozWarasanAradA । Suzyanti satataM tadvadvi cCAyAstAlupaYcamAH । dantaHkarajanetrAntA nIlimAnaM Bajanti cet । sahi kInASanagarIM zazWe mAsi vrajennaraH । saMpravftte niDuvane maDyAnte kzOti cennaraH । niScitaM paYcamemAsi DarmmarAjAtiTirBavet । drutamAruhya sarawastrivarRo yasya mastakam । prayAti, yAti tasyAyuH zaRmAse sampari kzayam । susnAtasyApi yasyASu hfdayaM pariSuzyati । caraRO ca karO vApi trimAsantasya jIvitam । prativimbe Bavedyasya padaNGaRqapadAkfti । pAMSO vA kardame vApi paYcamAsAn sa jIvati । CAyA prakampate yasya dehabanDe'pi niScale । kftAntadUtA baDnanti caturTe mAsi tannaram । nijasya prativimbasya nIrAjamukUwAdizu । uttamANgannayaH paSyet sa mAsena vinaSyati । matiBrArmyetssvaledvARI DanurEndraM niSIkzate । rAtrO, candradvayaM vApi divA dvO cA divAkarO । divA ca tArakAcakraM rAtrO vyoma vitArakam । yugapacca caturddikzuSAkraM kodaRqamaRqalam । BUruhe BUDarAgre vA ganDarvvanagarodayam । divA piSAcanftyaYca ete paYcatvahetavaH । sarvezvEtezu cihnezu yadyekamapi vIkzate । tadA mAsAvaDirmftyuH pratAkzeta nacADikam । karAvarudDaSravaRaH SfRoti na yadA Dvanim । sTUlaH kfSaH kfSaH sTUlastadA mAsAnnivarttate । yaH paSye dAtmanaSCAyAM dakziRASAsamASritAm । dinAni paYca jIvitvA paYcatvamupayAti saH । prohyate Bakzyate vApi piSAcAsuravAyasEH । BUtEH pretEH SvaBirgfDrErgomAyuKara SUkarEH । saraBEH karaBEH kISEH SyenEraSvatarEvfrkEH । svapnosa jovitaM tyaktvA varzAnte yamamIkzate । ganDapuzpAMSukEH SoREH svAntanuM BUzitAnnaraH । yaH paSyet svaprasamaye sO'zwOmAsAnanityaho । pASurASiYca valmIkaM yUpaM daRqamaTApi vA । yo'Dirohati vEsvapne zazWe mAsi sa naSyati । rAsaBArUQamAtmAnaM tElAByaktaYca muRqitam । nIyamAnaM yamASAM yaH svapne paSyet svapUrvvajAn । svapOlO svatanO vApi yaH paSyet svaptatonaraH । tfRAni SfzkakAzWAni zazWe mAsi na tizWati । lohadaRqaDaraM kfzRaM puruzaM kfzRa vAsasam । svayaM yo'gre sTitaM paSyet sa trInmAsAnna laNGa yet । kAlI kumArI yaM svapne baDnIyAdbAhupASakEH । sa mAsena samIkzeta nagarIM SamanozitAm । naro yo vAnarArUQaH prayAn prAcIM diSaM svapan । dinEH sa paYcamEreva paSyet saMyamarnI purIm । kfpaRo'pi vadAnyaH syAt vadAnyaH kfpaRoyadi । prakftirvikftiScetsapAttadA paYcatvamfcCati । etAni kAlacihnAni santyanyAni bahUnyapi । jYAtAByasyennaroyogamaTavA kASikAM Srayet । na kAlavaYcanopAyaM sune'nyamavayAmyaham” ।

v: strI kAlaH karRRo'syAH NIp । alakzmIBede “alakzmIH kAlakarRRI ca” purA॰ । svArTeka hrasvaH । kAlakarRikA tatrArTe hema॰ । alakzmISabde'nuktastadutpattyAdiratrABiDIyate pAdme uttaraKaRqe devIM prati SivavAkyam । “mAM praRamya punardevA mamanTuH kzIrasAgaram । tasmin pramaTyamAne tu mayA devESca BAvini! । jyezWA devI samutpannA raktasragvAsasAvftA । utpannA sA'bravIddevAn kiMkarttavyaM? mayeti vE । tAmabruvaMstadA devIM sarvve devagaRA stadA । yezAM gfhAntare nityaM kalahaM saMpravarttate । tatte sTAnaM prayacCAmo vAsastatra SuBAnane! । yasya gehaM kapAlAsTiBasmakeSAdicihnitam । paruzaM BAzate nityaM vasantyanftavAdinaH । sanDyAkAle ca ye pApAH svapanti malacetasaH । tezAM veSmani saMtizWa duHKadAridryadAyinI । kapAlakeSaBasmAsTituzANgArARi yatra tu । tatra te satataM sTAnaM Bavizyati na saMSayaH । akftvA pAdayoHSOcaM yastvAcAmati durmmatiH । taM Bajasva sadA devi! kaluzeRAvftA BfSam । tfRANgArakapAlASmabAlukAyasacarmmaBiH । dantaDAvana karttAro savizyanti narADamAH । ramasvakalinA devi! tezAM veSmasu nityaSaH । tilapizwaYca naktaYca kAliNgaSigrugfYjanam । CatrAkaM viqvarAhaYca vilvakozAtakIPalam । alAbUM (varttulAra) SrIPalaM yevE svAdayanti narADamAH । tezAM gfhe tava sTAna devi! dAridryade! sadA । ityAdiSya surAH sarve te jyezWAM kalivallaBAm” । tasyA uddAlakamuninA saha vivAhAdikaTA ca pAdme 161 a॰ । “samudramaTanAdyAni ratnAnyApuH surottamAH । SrezWaYca kOstuBaM tezu vizRave pradaduH surAH । yAvadaNgIcakArAsO lakzmIM BAryyArTamAtmanaH । tAvadvijYApayAmAsa lakzmIstaM cakrapARinam । lakzmIruvAca । asaMskftya kaTaM jyezWAM kanizWA pariRIyate । tasmAnmamAgrajAmetAmalakzmIM maDusUdana! । vivAhyodvaha mAM paScAdeza DarmmaH sanAtanaH tasmAt DarmmavyatikrAmaM na kuryyA maDusUdana! । iti taddacanaM SrutvA sa vizRurlokaBAvanaH । uddAlakAya munaye sudIrDa tapase tadA । AptavAkyAnuroDena tAmalakzmIM dadO kila । sTUlozWIM SuzkavadanAM virUpAM biBratIM tanum । sravadAraktanayanAM rUkzapakvaSiroruhAm । sa munirvizRuvAkyAttAmaNgIkftya svamASramam । vedaDvanisamAyuktamAnayAmAsa Darmmavit । homaDUpasuganDAdyaM vedaDozeRa nAditam । ASramaM taM vilokyATa vyaTitA sA'bravodidam । jyEzWovAca । na hi vAsonurUpo'yaM vedaDvaniyuto mama । nAtrAgamizye Bo brahman! nayasvAnyatra mAM Druvam । uddAlaka uvAca । kaTaM nAyAsi kiYcAtra? varttate svamataM tava । tavayogyA ca vasatiH kA Bavettadvadasva mAm । jyezWovAca । vedaDvanirBaved yasminnatiTInAYca pUjanam । yajYadAnAdikaM yatra nEva, tatra vasAmyaham । parasparAnurAgeRa dAmpatyaM yatra vidyate । pitfdevArccanaM yatra tatra nEva vasAmyaham । dAnaSOce na vidyete paradravyApahAriRaH । paradAraratA yatra tatra sTAne ratirmama । vfdDasajjanaviprARAM yatra syAdavamAnanam । nizWuraM BAzaRaM yatra tatra samyagvasAmyaham । sUta uvAca । iti tadvacanaM SrutrA vizaRRa vadano'Bavat । uddAlakastatovAkyaM tAmalakzmImuvAca ha । uddAlaka uvAca । aSvatTavfkzamUle'smin alakzmi! SramyatAM kzaRam । ASramasTAnamAlokya yAvadAyArmyahaM punaH । sUta uvAca । iti tAM tatra saMsTApya jAgAmoddAlako muniH । pratIkzantI ciraM tatra yadA na taM dadarSa sA । tadA ruroda karuRaM BarttustyAgena duHKitA । tattasyAH kranditaM lakzmIrvEkuRWaBavane'SfRot । tadA vijYApayAmAsa vizRumudvignamAnasA । lakzmIsvavAca । svAmin! madBaginI jyezWA svAmityAgena duHKitA । tAmASvAsayituM yAhikfpAlo! yadyahaM priyA । sUta uvAca । lakzmyA sahatato vizRustatrAgAt kfpayAnvitaH । ASvAsayanna lakzmIM tAmidaM vAkyamaTAbravIt । vizRuruvAca । aSvatTa vfkzamAsAdya sadA'lakzmi! sTirA Bava । mamAMSasamBavo hyeza AvAsaste sayA kftaH । mandavAre sadA nUnaM lakzmI ratrAgamizyati । aspfSyo'sO BavettasmAt mandavAraM vinA kila” । dIpAnvitAmAvasyAyAM tatpUjAviDAnaM mantraliNgAt yaTA “alakzmIstvaM kurUpAsi kutsitasTAnavAsini! । suKarAtrO mayA dattAM gfhRa pUjAYca SASvatIm । dAridrya kalahapriye devi! tvaM DananASinI । yAhi Satrogf'haM nityaM sTirA tatra Bavizyasi । yadi tvaM me mahABAge! prItA Bavasi sarvvadA । putrabanDukalatrezu kadAcinnA gamizyasi । gacCatvaM mandiraM SatrorgfhItvA cASuBaM mama । madASrayaM parityajya sTitA tatra Bavizyasi” । kiYca । “evaM gate niSITe tu nArIBiH svagfhANganAt । alakzmISca vahizkAryyA amantraYca yaTAviDi” iti kftyatattvArRavaDfta brahmapurARam । “evaM gate niSITe tu jane nidrArdDalocane । tAvannagaranArIBiH SUrpaqiRqimavAdanEH । nizkAsyate prahfzwABiralakzmIH svagfhANganAt” iti madanaratnaDftaYca । “grahakuzmARqaKewAdyAH kAlakarRISiSugrahAH” kASI॰

“jyezWA mUlamanurADA yA vITI saMprakIrttitA । tAYca vITIM samAruhya ketuScet krIqate BfSam । dakziRABinatAM kftvA SiKAM GorAM BayaNkarAm । SUlAgrasadfSIM tIkzRAM SyAvatAmrAruRapraBAm । pUrvveRa udita dakziRamanu parikramya astaM brajati । sa svarge dAruRakarmmA svargaprAptitvAdeva vakrAstamaBinihanti lokamapi ca । BUmiM kampayitvA daSa mAsAn maDyadeSe BUyizWaM janapadamavaSepaM kurute । tezvapi ca taTEva snehavarRayuktO kzemArogyasuBikzadO BavataH” parA॰ ।

s: puM, (kAlaH kAlacakraM puruza iva .) yamasahAyaH । iti jawADaraH ॥ jyotiHSAstram । yaTA “kintvasya kAlapuruzAKyamahArRavasya gacCet kadAcidanfzirmanasApi pAram” ॥ kAlapuruzaH sa cAKyA nAma yasyAsO tasya jyotiHSAstravistIrRasamudrasya । iti BawwotpalaH ॥ * ॥ narARAM SuBASuBajYAnArTaM janmalagnAdidvAdaSarASikalpitapuruzAkAraH । yaTA, -- “SIrzamuKabAhuhfdayodarARikawivastiguhyasaMjYakAni । UrUjAnukajaNGecaraRAviti ca rASayo'jAdyAH” ॥ iti dIpikA ॥ * ॥ narARAM SuBASuBajYAnArTaM janmalagnAdirASidrekkARaGawitapuruzAkAraH । yaTA, “kaM dfkSrotranasAkapolahanavo vaktraYca horAdayaste kaRWAMSakabAhupArSvahfdayakroqAninABistataH । vastiH SiSnagude tataSca vfzaRAvUrUtato jAnunI jaNkzANGrI hyuBayatra vAmamuditErdrekkARaBAgEstriDA” ॥ iti “kAlanarasyANgesadasadgrahayogataH । puMsAmapi tadaNgezu SuBASuBaPalaM vadet” ॥ iti vfhajjAtakam ॥
v: pu॰ kAlaH kAlacakraM puruza iva । mezAdidvAdaSa rASisvarUpe kAlavyavahArakArake puruzAkAre gaganasTe 1 vAyucakraBede । tasya ca janmAdO SuBASuBajYAnAya yaTANgAdiviBAgaH, taTA vfhajjAtake uktaM yaTA “SIrzaM muKabAhU hfdayodarARi kawiastiguhyasaMjYakAni । jAnuUrNGeca ca UrU caraRAviti rASayo'jAdyAH” tasyArTaH । “mezaH SirovfzovaktraM miyunaM bAhuyugyakam । karkawohfdayaYcEba sihastUdarameva ca । kanyA kawistulA vastirvfSciko guhyameva ca । DanurUrU mfgo jAnu kumBojaNGe prakIrttite । mInaH pAdadvayaYcEvANgAni kAlanarasya tu” । tataSca yadaNgarASirASISO dIrGO tadaNgaM dIrGaM, tayorlaGutve laGu, rASirASISayorBinnarUpatve maDyamam iti kalpyam । lagnadrekkARaBedenANgaviSezaH tatddyekkARe sadasadgrahayogena PalaviSezaSca vfhajjA॰ uktaH yaTA । “kaM dfkSrotranasAkapolahanavo vaktraYca horAdayaste kaRWAMsakavAhupArSvahfdayakroqAni nABistataH । vastiH SiSnagude tataSca vfzaRAvUrU tato jAnunI--jaNGraNGrI hyuBayatra vAmamuditEdrekkARaBAgEstiDA” vacanasyAyamarTaH triBirdrekkARaBAgEstriDA dehaviBAga iti SezaH । tatra praTamena drekkARena mUrdDAdyaNgaM, dvitIyena kaRWAdi, tftIyena vastyAdi । tatrApyvaditErdfSyaBAgasTErvAmamaNgamanuditEradfSyaBAgasTErdakziRANgamityarTaH । taTAca lagnAt dvAdaSEkAdaSadaSamanavamAzwamasaptamAH uditaBAgasTA dfSyAH । anuditaBAgasTo'dfSyaH saca lagnAt dvitIyatftIyacaturTapaYcamazazWasaptamAMSaBedaBAgasTaH । taTAcAyamarTaH praTamedrekkARa lagnaM SiraH, dvitIye dvAdaSe ca krameRa dakzavAme dfSO, tftIyEkAdaSayoH dakzavAmaSrotre, caturTapaYcamayoH, dakzavAme nAse, paYcamanavaBayo, dakzavAmakapolO, zazWAzwamayoH dakzavAme hanU, saptamaM muKam । lagnage dvitIye drekkARe lagnaM kaRWaH, dvitIyadvAdaSayoH dakzavABaskanDO, tftIyEkAdaSayoH dakzavAmO bAhU, caturTadaSamayoH dakzavAme pArSve paYcamanavamayoH dakzavamO hfdBAgO, zazWAzwamayoH dakzavAmO udaraBAgO, saptamaM nABiH । lagnasya tftIye drekkARe lagnaM vastiH (nABiliNgamaDyaBAgaH) dvitIyadvAdaSayoH dakzavAmO SiSnaguhyaBAgO, tftIyEkAdaSayoH dakzavAmO UrU । paYcamanavapnayoH dakzavAme jAnunI । zazWAzWamayoH dakzavAme jaNGe, saptamaM pAdAviti । iti mahIDarakftavyAKyAnusAri । tatPalamAha tatrEva “tasmin pApayute vraRaM, SuBayute sOmyaM, hi lakzmAdiSet । svarkzAMSe sTira 2, 5, 8, 11, saMyute ca sahajaH, syAdanyaTA''gantakaH । mande KAnilajo'gniSastravizajo BOme, buDe (pApayute) BUBavaH, sUryye kAzWacatuzpadAcca, himagO (hInacandre) SfNgyabjajo'nye SuBAH” । kAlapuruzaH pratipAdyatayAstyasya ac । 2 jyotiHSAstre “kintvasya kAlapuruzasya mahArRavasya gacCet kadAcidanrzirmanasA'pi pAram” BawwotpalaH । karmma॰ । 3 kfzRavarRRapuruze । kAlaH puruza iva । dAnArTaM kalpite puruzAkAre 3 kAlarUpeSvaramUrttiBede pu॰ tatprakAro hemA॰ dA॰ Ka॰ uktoBavizyo॰ pu॰ yaTA “kAmyodAnaviDiH pArTa! kriyamARo yaTAtaTam । PalAya muniBiH prokto viparIto BayAya ca । jYeyaM nizkaSataM pArTa! dAnezu viDiruttamaH । maDyamastu tadardDena tadardDenADamaH smftaH । mezyAYca kAlapuruze taTAnyezu mahatsu ca । evaM vfkze raTe'Rqe ca DenoH kfzRAjinasya ca । aSaktasyApi klizwo'yaM paYcasOvarRikoviDiH । ato'pyalpena yodadyAt mahAdAnaM narADipa! । pratigfhRAti vA tasya duHKaSokAvahaM Bavet । puRyandinamaTAsAdya BUmiBAge same Sume । caturddaSyAM caturTyAM vA vizTAM va pARqunandana! । pumAn kfzRatilEH kAryyorOpyadantaH suvarRRadfk” । suvarRRAdiparImARamatra yaTASakti sampAdanIyam । KaqgodyatakarodIrGojavAkusumakuRqalaH । raktAmbaraDaraH sragvI SaNKamAlAviBUzitaH । tIkzRAsiputrIbanDena visfgdArikawItawaH । upAnaduyuayuktANGriH kfzRakambalapArSvagaH । gfhItamAMsapiRqaSca vAme karatale taTA । evaMviDaM naraM kftvA gfhItakusumAYjaliH । yajamAnaH prasannAtmA imaM mantramudIrayeta । sampUjya ganDakusumErnEvedyaM vinivedya ca । sarvvaM kalayase yasmAt kAlastvaM tena cocyase । brahmavizRuSivAdInAM tvamArADyo'si suvrata! । pUjitastvaM mayA BaktyA pArTivaSca taTAsuKam । yadbuDyate tava viBo! tatkuruzva namonamaH । evaM saMpUjayitvA taM brAhmaRAya nivedayet । brAhmaRaM praTamaM pUjya vAsoBirBUzaREstaTA । dakziRAM Saktito dadyAt praRipatya visarjjayet” । dakziRAM pUrvvoktAM nizkAdikAm “anena biDinA yastu dAnametat prayacCati । na ca mftyuBayaM tasya na ca vyADikftaM Bavet । BavatyavyAhatESvaryyaH sarvabADAvivarjjitaH । dehAnte sUryyaBavanaM BittvA yAti paraM padam । puRyakzayAdihAgatya rAjA Bavati DArmmikaH । satrayAjI SriyA yuktaH putrapOtrasamanvitaH । saMpUjya kAlapuruzaM biDivaddvijAya dattvA SuBASuBaPalodayahetuBUtam । rogAture sakaladozamaye'tra dehe dehI na mohamupagacCati tatpraBAvAt” ।
m: काल—पुरुष m. = -नर, time personified, VarBṛS.
a servant of the god of death, Kād.

the night of a man's death, Pañcad.
a particular night in the life of a man (on the seventh day of the seventh month of the seventy-seventh year, after which period a man is exempt from attention to the usual ordinances), L.
N. of a Brāhman woman (skilled in magic), Kathās. xx, 104.

s: strI, (kAlaH kAlarUpA brahmEkadine caturddaSamanUnAmaDikArAvasAne sfzwisaMhArahetuBUtA rAtriH .) rAtriviSezaH । sA tu kAlaH saMhAraH । maraRaM tadupalakzitArAtriH kalpAntarAtrirityarTaH । iti devImAhAtmyawIkAyAM vidyAvinodaH ॥ BImaraTI । iti hArAvalI ॥ durgAyAH SaktiviSezaH । yaTA, -- “sA dUrgA SaktiBiH sArdDaM kASIM rakzati sarvvataH । tAH prayatnena saMpUjyAH kAlarAtrimuKA narEH” ॥ iti kASIKaRqam ॥ (dIpAvalI । yaTA, -- “dIpAvalI tu yA proktA kAlarAtriSca sA matA” । ityAgamavacanAt । kriyAyogyakAlaviSezaH । yaduktaM dIpikAyAm । “ravO zazWaM viDO vedaM kujavAre dvitIyakam । vuDe sapta gurO paYca BfguvAre tftIyakam ॥ SanAvAdyaM taTA cAntaM rAtrO kAlaM vivarjayet” ॥)
v: strI kAlo rAtririva kAlasya KaRqakAlasya rAtririva aprakASakatvAt । 1 pralayarAtrO 2 pralayakAle tatra sarvvacezwArAhityAt taTAtvam । “yadA sa devo jAgartti tadedaM cezwate jagat । yadA svapiti SAntAtmA tadA sarvaM pralIyate” iti manunA pralayakAle sarvvacezwArAhityoktestatkAlasya rAtrirUpatvam । 3 durgAmUrttiBede sA ca “kAlarAtri maTovakzye sapatnagaRasUdanIm” ityupakramya mantra mahodacO 18 taraNge uktA, tatrEva tasyA mantrapUjAdikaM dfSyam । “SaktiBiHsahitA durgA kArSIM rakzati sarvvataH । tAH prayatnena saMpUjyAH kAlarAtrimuKA narEH” kASIKa॰ “kAlarAtrirmahArAtrirmoharAtriScadAruRA” devImA॰ vyAkftaYcEtad guptavatyAM yaTA “kAlarAtriH sarvvajantumaraRopalakzitA kalparAtriH । mahArAtriH brahmalayopalakzitA mahApralayarAtriH, moharAtriH mohAvarttagarttapAtinI mahAmAyAKyA saMsftikarttrI, yadvA dEnandinapralayabrahmapralayamokzarUpamahApralayarUparAtraya iti padatrayasyArTaH । 4 tatpratipAdakamantraBede ca aBedopacArAt sa ca mantraH bahvfcagranTe rAtrisUktatvena prasidDaH । sAmaBede ca “rutriM prapadye” ityAdiH । 5 BImaraTyAm (ativfdDavayaske) hArA॰ । sarvaprARinASikAyAM 6 yamaBaginyAM BAvapra॰ । 7 dIpAnvitAmAvasyAyAm “dIpAvalI tu yA proktA kAlarAtriSca sA matA” ityAgamokteH ।

s: puM, (kAlaH kAlarUpaH sarvvasaMhArako rudraH .) kAlAgnirudraH । yaTA, devIpurARe, -- “yezu naH kAlarudrasya nAnAstrISatasaNkulA । vicitraharmmyavinyAsA kutaste merupfzWataH ॥ sA eva kAlarudrasya tanurUpeRa saMsTitA” ॥
v: pu॰ kAlarUpo rudraH । kAlarUpapralayAgnirUpe rudraBede “yAH puraH kAlarudrasya nAnAstrISatasaNkulAH । vicitraharmyavinyAsAH kutastA merupfzWataH । tAeva kAlarudrasya tanurUpeRa saMsTitAH । yA parA SivarUpeRa paramA padadAyikA । tasyA yadduHsahaM tejo brahmAdInAM kzayaNkaram । taM vidDi kAlarudreti sOmyarUpaM sadASivam । kAlAgnivyasanaM (vyAsaH) lakzaM yojanAnAM pramARataH । ardDenocCrayatastasva pAdaH pAdena BAsate । siMharUpA mahAGorA mahAnakramahAbalAH । kAlAgni rudrarUpo yobahurUpasamAvftaH । anantapadmarUpaSca DAtuSca kAraReSvaraH । dAruRAgniSca rudraSca yamahantA kzayAntakaH” devIpu॰ । kAlAgnirudro'pyatra
m: काल—रुद्र m. Rudra regarded as the fire that is to destroy the world, DevībhP.

v: na॰ kAlena samAnaH Ahvayoyasya । kAlasUtrA Kye narakaBede “yo manuzyaH svakaM putraM vikrIya DanamicCati । kanyAM vA jIvitAryAya yaH Suklena prayacCati । saptAvare mahAGore niraye kAlasAhvaye । svedaM mUtraM purIzaYca tasmin mUQaH samaSnute” BA॰ Adu॰ 45 a॰ ।

s: strI, (kAlasya velA .) kreyAnarhakAlaviSezaH । sA tu ravyAdivAre kAlasya SanestattadyAmArdDarupavelA । yaTA । ravO divA paYcamayAmArdDaM nakta zazWayAmArdDam । some divA dvitIyayAmArdDaM naktaM caturTayAmArdDam । kuje divA zazwayAmArdDaM naktvaM saptamayAmArdDam । vuDe divA tftoya yAmArdDaM naktaM saptamayAmArdDam ॥ gurO divA saptamayAmArdDaM naktaM paYcamayAmArdDam । Sukre divA caturTayAmArdDaM naktaM tftIyayAmArdDam । SanO divA praTamAzwamayAmArdDaM naktaM tadeva । iti dIpikA ॥ laSAkaM, klI, (kAlaM kfzRaM SAkam .) svanAmaKyAtaSAkam । naracA iti hindI BAzA । tatparyyAyaH । nAqikam 2 SrAdDaSAkam 3 kAlakam 4 । asya guRAH । sArakatvam । rucivAyubalakAritvam । kaPaSoTaraktapittanASitvam । meDyatvam । himatvaYca । iti BAvaprakASaH ॥ tiktapUtikA । kulatTaSAkaM iti kecit । asya guRAH । kawutvam । agnidIpanatvam । gurutvam । SoTanASitvaYca । iti rAjavallaBaH ॥ (yaTA ca vABawe sUtrasTAne । 6 aDyAye । “varzABvO kAlaSAkaYca sakzAraM kawutiktakam । dIpanaM BedanaM hanti garaSoPakaPAnilAn” ॥)

v: pu॰ karmma॰ । yavanADipe nfpaBede । “miTyABiSasto gArgyastu manyunABisamIritaH । gopakanyAmupAdAya mETunAyopacakrame । gopAlI tvapsarAstasya gopastrIveSaDAriRI । DArayAmAsa gArgyasya garBaM durdDaramacyuta! । mAnuzyAM gArgyaBAryyAyAM niyogAcCUlapARinaH । sa kAlayavanonAma jajYe rAjAmahAbalaH । vfzapUrvvArdDakAyAstamavahan vAjino raRe । aputrasya sa rAjYastu vavfDe'ntaHpure SiSuH । yavanasya mahArAja! sa kAlayavano'Bavat । sa yodDukAmo nfpatiH paryyapfcCaddvijottamam । vfzRyanDakakulaM tasya nArado'kaTayadviBuH । akzOhiRyA tu sEnyasya maTurAmaByayAttadA । dUtaM samprezayAmAsa vfzRyanDakaniveSanam । tatovfzRyanDakAH kfzRaM puraskftya mahAmatim । sametAmantrayA mAsuryavanasya BayAttadA । kftvA ca niScayaM sarvve palAyanamarocayan । vihAya maTurAM ramyAM mAnayantaH pinAkinam । kuSasTalIM hAravatIM niveSayitumIpsavaH” hari॰ 36 a॰ । “asti tasya raRe jetA yavanADipatirnfpaH । sa kAlayavano nAma abaDyaH keSavasTa ha । tatvA sudAruRaM GoraM tapaH paramaduScaram । rudramArADayAmAsa dvAdaSAbdAn yaSoDanaH । putrakAmeRa muninAtozyarudraM suto vftaH । mATurARAmamabaDyo'sO Bavediti ca SaNkarAt । evamastviti rudro'pi pradadO munaye sutam । evaM gArgyasya tanayaH SrImAn rudravarodBavaH । mATurARAmabaDyo'sO maTurAyAM viSezataH । kfzRo'pi balavAneza mATuro jAtavAnayam” harivaM 111 a॰ । “vAsudevastu taM dfzwvA nihataM yogamAtmanaH । utsfjya maTurAmASu dvArakAmaBijagmivAn! vErasyAntaM viDitsaMstu vAsudevo mahAyaSAH । niveSya dvArakAM rAjan! vfzRInASvAsya cEva ha । padAtiH puruzavyAGro bAhupraharaRastadA । AjagAma mahAyogI maTurAM maDusUdanaH । taM dfzwvA niryayO hfzwaH sakAlayavanoruzA । prekzApUrvvaYca kfzRo'pi niScakrAma mahAbalaH । aTAnvagacCadgovindaM jiGfkzuryavaneSvaraH । na cEnamaSakadrAjA grahItuM yogaDarmiRam । mAndAtustu suto rAjA mucukundo mahAyaSAH । purA devAsure yudve kftakarmA mahAbalaH । vareRa cCandito devErnidrAmeva gfhItavAn । SrAntasya tasya vAgevaM tadA prAduraBUt kila । prasuptaM boDayedyo mAM taM daheyamahaM surAH! । cakzuzA kroDadIptenetyevamAha punaH punaH । evamastviti taM Sakra uvAca tridaSEH saha । sa surEraByanujYAtatvadrirAjamupAgamat । sa parvvataguhAM kAYcit praviSya SramakarzitaH । suzvApa kAlametaM vE yAvat kfzRasya darSanam । tat sarvvaM vAsudevasya nAradena niveditam । varadAnaYca deveByastejastasya ca BUpateH । kfzRo'nugamyamAnaSca tena mlecCena SatruRA । tAM guhAM mucukundasya praviveSa vinItavat । SiraHsTAne tu rAjarzermucukundasya keSavaH । sandarSanapaTaM tyaktvA tasTO budDimatAM varaH । anupraviSya yavano dadarSa pfTivIpatim । sa taM suptaM kftAntABamAsasAda sudurmmatiH । vAsudevantu taM matvA GawwayAmAsa pArTivam । pAdena pAdamAkramya pAdasprarSapraboDitaH । cukopa nidrAcCedena pAdasparSena tena ca । sa saMsmftya varaM SakrAdavEkzata tamagrataH । sa dfzwamAtraH krudDena sa prajajvAla sarvvataH । dadAha pAvakastantu SuzkaM vfkzamivASaniH । kzaRena kAla yavanaM netratejovinirgataH” hari॰ 115 a॰ । tadbaGakaTA

m: कालि-दास m. (fr. काली, the goddess Durgā, and दास, a slave, the final of काली being shortened; cf. Pāṇ. vi, 3, 63), N. of a celebrated poet (author of the Śakuntalā, Vikramorvaśī, Mālavikāgnimitra, Megha-dūta, and Raghu-vaṃśa; described as one of the nine gems of Vikramāditya's court, and variously placed in the first, second, third, and middle of the sixth century A.D.; the name is, however, applied to several persons, especially to two others who may have written the Nalodaya and Śruta-bodha [hence the N. is used to denote the number, ‘three’], and seems, in some measure, to have been used as an honorary title).
a: कालिदास — The celebrated author of the अभिज्ञानशकुंतल, विक्रमोर्वशीय, मालविकाग्निमित्र, रघुवंश, कुमारसंभव, मेघदूत, ऋतुसंहार; also of the poems नलोदय and of some other minor works. The earliest known authentic reference to Kālidāsa is in an inscription dated 556 Śake or 634 A. D., in which he and Bhāravi are spoken of as being renowned poets. The verse is as follows:-- येनायोजि न वेश्म स्थिरमर्थविधौ विवेकिना जिनवेश्म . स विजयतां रविकीर्तिः कविताश्रितकालिदासभारविकीर्तिः .. Bāṇa's reference to him in the beginning of his Harṣa-charita also shows that he must have flourished before the time of Bāṇa, i. e. before the first half of the seventh century. But how long before the seventh century the poet flourished is not yet known. According to Mallinātha's explanation on Me. 14 निचुल and दिङ्नाग were contemporaries of Kālidāsa. If Mallinātha's suggestion be correct-and it is very doubtful if it be really so-then our poet must have lived in the middle of the sixth century which is the date usually assigned to दिङ्नाग. There is one point which, if definitely settled, would give the poet's precise date. It is the mention by Kālidāsa of his patron Vikrama. Who this Vikrama is it has not yet been definitely settled. Popular tradition identifies him with the founder of the Saṃvat Era which is said to have commenced 56 B. C. If this view be correct, Kālidāsa must be considered as belonging to the first century before Christ. But some scholars have recently come to the conclusion that what is called the era of Vikramāditya 56. B. C. was a date arrived at by taking the date of the great battle of Korūr in which Vikrama finally defeated the Mlecchas, i. e. 544 A. D. and then by throwing back the beginning of the new era 600 years before that date, i. e. 56 B. C. If this conclusion be accepted as correct-and scholars do not seem to have yet agreed on the point-Kālidāsa must have flourished in the sixth century A. D. The question is still an open one.

s: klI, (kAlikAyAH prItaye yadvrataM vihitaniyamAdikam .) amAvAsyAyAM strAkarttavyavrataviSezaH । yaTA, -- yuDiMzWira uvAca । “kAlikAvratamAhAtmyaM vada vedavidAmbara ! । kimetasya PalaM deva ko vA tadviDireva ca ॥ kasmAdvratamidaM BUtaM martye kena prakASitam । tvattastat SrotumicCAmi tatsarvvaM brUhi keSava !” ॥ SrIkfzRa uvAca । “purA mavizyaSAstrezu yaduktaM DarmmasaMhitam । tatsarvvaM SfRu rAjendra ! kAlikAvratamuttamam ॥ svarge purandaraScAsIttasyEva rAjasadmani । yadvfttAntamaBUttatra tacCfRuzva yuDizWira ! ॥ saBAyAM saMsTito rAjA nftyAsakto hi nityaSaH । dinEkasya ca vfttAntaM SrutvA hfzwo baBUva saH ॥ atyAmodaM samaByetya puzpavfzwiramuttadA । purandaraH svayaM prApya pArijAtaM gfhItavAn ॥ GrAtvA rAjYA tadA puzpaM pradattaM taddvijAtaye । lajjito brAhmaRaH so'pi mAnahIno'BavattadA ॥ kroDena mahatAvizwaH SaptuM kAmasamanvitaH । kzaRaM vimfzya cendrAya SApo dattaH sudAruRaH ॥ vyADAlayezu mArjjAro dvAdaSAbdaM Bavizyasi । tena karmmavipAkena madayukto vicetanaH ॥ prAptamArjjAradeho'sO rAjA vipinamAsTitaH । patnI tasya ca tatrAsIt patyuH sarvvADikAriRI ॥ tato vyADagfhe rAjA mArjjArIBUya tizWati । tataH purandarapuraM rAjaSUnyamaBUttadA ॥ SacI tu cintAyAmAsa annapAnaM vihAya sA । upavAsaM samAcaryya mAsamekantu tizWati ॥ tato devagaRAH sarvve cintayA vyAkulendriyAH । gatvA tu rAjaBavanaM vyAkulAM tAM vilokya ca ॥ vimfzya cAmarAH sarvve SacyE vAkyamudAharan । Saci ! tvaM rAjajAyAsi kaTametat karozi ca ॥ mAsamekamanAhAraM kftvA tizWasi suvrate ! । kiM vA tvadIpsitaM devi ! satyena vada paRqite ॥ tacCrutvA tu tadA devI kftAYjaliraBAzata । yUyameva jagannATAH sfzwisTitTantakArakAH ॥ kva gato mama BarttA ca tanna jAnAmi katTatAm । paricintyAmarAH sarvva DyAnamAsTAya saMsTitAH ॥ mArjjArarUpamAsTAya sTIyate cAntyajASrame । tacCrutvA rAjapatnI ca vepamAnA muhurmuhuH ॥ uvAca kuSalaM praSnaM rAjArTaM kiM karomyaham । patyuryaTA vimokzaH syAt tat kuruDvaM suDASanAH ॥ pratyUcuScAmarAH sarvve yAhi tvaM dijasanniDim । saMBAvya maDuraM praSnaM dvijasevAM samAcara । dvijagehaM samAgatya dvijasevAparA'Bavat ॥ sa tasyAH priyakAryyeRa santuzwo dvijasattamaH । hiMsAdrohavimuktaSca balihomaparAyaRaH । SAnto dAntaH kzamAyuktaH sadA maDuraBAzitaH ॥ sarvvaprARihitArTI ca loBamohavivarjjitaH । jitendriyo jitakroDo vfdDo'sO brAhmaRottamaH ॥ rAjapatnyAH susevABiH prIto'sO dvijasattamaH । pratyuvAca sa tAM prItyA Saci ! tvaM cAtidurllaBe । kiM vA tvadIpsitaM devi ! satyena vada paRqite” ॥ SacyuvAca । “pApaM yajjYAnato BartrA samastaM karmmaRA kftam tat kzamasva mahABAga ! rakzasva surapAlakam ॥ vAsavastava SApena mArjjAratvamupAgataH । indro vyADagfhe deva ! vidyate hi na saMSayaH । purandarasya SApAntaH kenopAyena siDyati” ॥ brAhmaRa uvAca । “Saci ! tvaM patiBaktAsi madvAkyamavaDAraya । pativrate ! mahABAge ! kAlikAvratamAcara ॥ dAruRaM yat kftaM tena vratenEva vimucyate । kopAt SApo mayA datto tanmokzaM kuru suvrate !” ॥ SacyuvAca । “viDAnaM brUhi me brahman kAlikAyA vratasya ca । tadA tava prasAdena karomi tadvrataM dvija !” ॥ brAhmaRa uvAca । “aSvatTatarumUle'sti vawako nAma hiMsakaH । tasyEva BavanaM gacCa SApAnmokzaM ca kAraya ॥ patnI suBadrA tasyAsti patiSuSrUzaRe ratA । tasyAH kulavrataM karmma tatparA Bava SoBane । tataSca prANmaKIBUya gatA sA tasya mandiram ॥ dfzwvA vyADaH SacIM devIM pratyuvAca suBadrikAm । AyAntIyaM SacI devI tasyAH samBAzaRaM kuru ॥ iti tasya vacaH SrutvA suBadrA hfzwamAnasA । tasyAH samBAzaRarTantu suBadrA cAgatA vahiH । tAYca dfzwvA SacIM devIM sArGyapAdyAdikaM dadO ॥ Saci ! tvaM rAjaBAryyAsi kasmAdAgamanaM tava । kiM kAryyaM kaTaya tvaM hi ityuvAca SacIM prati ॥ pratyuvAca SacI tAntu BartA me surapAlakaH । sa ca brAhmARaSApena mArjjAraScABavaddrutam ॥ kva gataH prARaATo'sAviti cintAparAniSam । jYAtvA kenApyupAyena prAptA ca BavatIgfham ॥ ityuktA rAjapatnyA ca dfzwo mArjjArakastadA । sA jYAtvA taM priyaM SakraM cintAM prAptA duratyayAm ॥ dfzwvA mArjjAratAM prAptaM vilalApAkulendriyA । vilapantIM SacIM dfzwvA suBadrA pratyuvAca tAm ॥ pativrate mahABAge ! tvameva rAjagehinI । tvaM duHKena viliptAsi sandeho nAsti tatra vE ॥ kila tasyApyupAyo'sti kAlikAvratamAcara । atipratTakzarUpA sA asmAkaM kuladevatA ॥ kAlikA sA mahAdevI SuBasantatidAyinI । vratasyAsya praBAveRa sAkalyamupajAyate” ॥ SacyuvAca । “viDAnaM cAsya me brUhi kAlikAyA vratasya ca । mamopadiSyatAmeva tadvrataYca karoByaham ॥ SudDakAle samAraBya kfzRapakze caturddaSIm ॥ saMkalpya viDinA pUrvvamamAvAsyAM vrataM caret । samAraBya guREkena dviguRaM pariSoDayet ॥ na rAtrO BojanaM kAryyaM vAmahaste BujikriyA । sidDamannaM rAtrikAle dagDamInaYca sarvvadA ॥ varjjayet pizwakaM kiYcit raktaSAkasya cAmlakam । dvizawkAM viprajAyAYca saDavAM BojayettataH ॥ evaM krameRa kftvA tu katikAlaM nayedvratam । tataH SudDadine prApte BOmAhe mandavAsare ॥ yaTASaktyupacArESca pUjAM kuryyAdviDAnataH । taTAparAhRakAle tu sanDyopasamaye taTA ॥ rAtrO tu kadalIkARqe gfhaM nirmmAya prANgaRe । tasya maDye samAropya kAlikAM pUjayet sadA ॥ pAdyArGyAcamanIyESca ganDapuzpAdiBistaTA । DUpErdivyapradIpESca nEvedyErviviDEstaTA ॥ pizwakaM cEva sidDAnnaM vyaYjanaM dagDamInakam । nivedya sakalaM devyE baliM dattvA praRamya ca ॥ tadannaM vyaYjanaM sarvvaM nEvedyAdibaliM taTA । mahAraRye pradAtavyaM kftvEtat vratamuttamam ॥ vERave kadalImUle yA kuryyAt kAlikAvratam । kAryyasidDirBavet tasyA BavitA gatiruttamA ॥ etadvrataviDAnantu kftvA sidDirBavizyati । etadvratamidaM Badre kuru gatvA nijAlayam ॥ tasyAstadvacanaM SrutvA sA SacI harzamAnasA । gfhamAgatya sA tasyA vArzikaM vratamAcarat ॥ ganDapuzpErDUpadIpErnEvedyEruttamEstaTA । kftvA cASmamayIM devIM pUjayet BaktisaMyutA ॥ nAnAsuganDipuzpARi divyaratnAdyalaNkftam । sidDAnnaM pAyasaYcEva SarkarAnvitapizwakam ॥ amftAyutahAvaYca dIyate ca prayatnataH । lulApacCAgamezAdibaliM dattvA praBUtakam ॥ nAnAvAdyo dyamErgItEH praRipatya punaH punaH । kftAYjalipuwA stotraM BaktinamrA cakAra sA ॥ tuzwA prAha mahAkAlI varaM vfRu SuBAnane ! । tat SrutvA rAjapatnI sA baBAze ca mudAnvitA ॥ matpraBurAKuBuk BUtastanmokzaM kuru ceSvari ! । varaM dattvA hEmavatI baBUvAntarhitA nfpa ! ॥ dvAdaSAbdAcca tatSApAnmocito vatsare tadA । mArjjArarUpaM santyajya sa gato'nte'marAvatIm ॥ puzpavfzwiSca dunduByA vAdyaM devagaREH kftam । kAlikAyAH prasAdena gataH Sakro nijAlayam ॥ anenEva viDAnena yA kuryyAt kAlikAvratam । satvaraM kAryyasidDiH syAttasyA atra na saMSayaH” ॥ iti BavizyapurARe kAlikAvratakaTA samAptA ॥
